nodes.title: Product, General
nodes.definition: General information for the complete Product, procedures for the Product safety and general Product maintenance, use of the Product safety and protective devices, information on the technical publication required to support the Product.

nodes.title: Product, Description
nodes.definition: General description with illustrations of the Product and its systems to include type of Product, its roles, accommodation, salient constructional features, power system installation, systems and operational equipment.

nodes.title: Product, General maintenance
nodes.definition: Those instructions necessary for the Product maintenance condition, electrical (static) grounding.

nodes.title: Product, Safety
nodes.definition: Those specific or Product peculiar instructions necessary to make safe and prepare the Product for maintenance action. Includes instructions for returning the Product to its serviceable state.

nodes.title: Safety and protective devices
nodes.definition: Those instructions necessary for the use or operation of devices such as safety pins, safety locks, safety pin flag assemblies, safety struts, safety strut extensions, etc. Instructions for removal and installation of protective covers, bungs, blanks, etc, are to be included.

nodes.title: Technical publication
nodes.definition: Information on the technical publication required to support the Product (not a technical publication project in its own right) such as the Lists of Applicable Publications, Publication Guide, the coding system of technical publications, instruction for handling and updating technical publication.

nodes.title: Publications
nodes.definition: Information on the suite of publications that are required by the customer.

nodes.title: Information Sets
nodes.definition: Information on the information sets that were used to produce the suite of publications that are required by the customer.

nodes.title: Material data
nodes.definition: Information concerning all material (products) used for the maintenance of the complete Product and its systems.

nodes.title: Battle damage repair
nodes.definition: Information and data which cannot be allocated to a specific SNS because the involved zone of the Product contains more than one hardware "system".

nodes.title: Worthiness (fit for purpose) limitations
nodes.definition: This System provides guidance for the calculation of lives for critical items/components and defines the operating parameters for such calculations.

nodes.title: Fatigue index calculations
nodes.definition: Procedures and formulae for calculating Fatigue Index/Fatigue Lives of the Product structure from Fatigue Meter readings.

nodes.title: Operating spectrums
nodes.definition: Assumed operating spectrums for the Product from which the safe fatigue lives are calculated.

nodes.title: Scheduled/unscheduled maintenance
nodes.definition: Manufacturers’ recommendation for time limits inspection (both scheduled and unscheduled).

nodes.title: Time limits
nodes.definition: Those manufacturer recommended time limits for maintenance and overhaul of the Product, its systems and subassemblies, and life of its parts.

nodes.title: Scheduled maintenance checks lists
nodes.definition: A list of the manufacturer recommended scheduled and unscheduled maintenance checks and inspections, including operating tests applicable to the Product, its systems and sub-assemblies. The checks listed at -40, -50 and -60 must be included.

nodes.title: Scheduled maintenance checks
nodes.definition: Those manufacturer recommended maintenance checks and inspections of the Product, its systems and sub-assemblies dictated by the time limits specified in -10 above. This section lists in more detail the items which are outlined on the user job forms (usually by title only) and cross references the detailed procedures included in the individual maintenance practices.

nodes.title: Unscheduled maintenance checks
nodes.definition: Those maintenance checks and inspections on the Product, its systems and sub-assemblies which are dictated by special or unusual conditions which are not related to the time limits specified in -10 above.

nodes.title: Acceptance and functional check usage
nodes.definition: Those current status functional checks necessary to fulfill inspection requirements to prove the safety/usage of all components and systems following delivery or maintenance activities.

nodes.title: Maintenance allocation
nodes.definition: The maintenance authority and responsibility for the performance of maintenance functions on a Product, including grouped maintenance functions (where necessary), lists of tools and lists of remarks.

nodes.title: Dimensions and areas
nodes.definition: Those illustrations and text which show the principal dimensions of the Product and the zones, areas and reference lines used to locate sub-assemblies/components. It also includes all access and drainage provisions.

nodes.title: Principal dimensions
nodes.definition: To include a conventional 3-view illustration of the Product with principal dimensions.

nodes.title: Reference lines
nodes.definition: To include a system for locating sub-assemblies/components in relation to the Product reference lines.

nodes.title: Zones and areas
nodes.definition: To include Product sub-division by zone/area to identify the zone/area in which the maintenance task is done.

nodes.title: Access provisions
nodes.definition: To identify all access doors and panels, and maintenance access points. Note Walkways are covered in System 12.

nodes.title: Lifting, shoring, recovering and transporting
nodes.definition: Includes all necessary procedures to lift the Product with jacks or slings, and to recover it in any of the conditions to which it can be subjected, including maintenance and repair. It also includes information on recovering the Product from any condition to which it can be subjected (including emergency recovering) and how to transport it by air/road/rail, etc.

nodes.title: Jacking
nodes.definition: Information on jacking points, adapters, balance weights, jacking procedures and the jacks used to lift the Product during Product maintenance, repair and recovery.

nodes.title: Shoring
nodes.definition: Information on shoring points, shoring procedures and the shoring equipment used during Product maintenance, repair and recovery.

nodes.title: Slinging
nodes.definition: Information on slinging points, slinging procedures and the slings used to lift the Product during maintenance, repair and recovery.

nodes.title: Recovering
nodes.definition: Information on recovery procedures and the tools and equipment required to recover the Product from any condition to which it can be subjected, including emergency recovery.

nodes.title: Transporting
nodes.definition: Information on how to dismantle the Product to a standard of breakdown consistent with the Product in which it can have to be transported. Information for the manufacture of transportation sledges or pallets. For removal procedures and maintenance information, refer to appropriate system/subsystem.

nodes.title: Leveling and weighing
nodes.definition: This System includes the necessary information to level the Product for any of the various maintenance, overhaul or major repairs which becomes necessary during the life of the Product. It also includes those on- Product sub-assemblies or components which are specifically dedicated to record, store or compute mass and balance data. Includes those maintenance practices necessary to prepare the Product for weighing and the weighing procedure. Mass and center of gravity (c.g.) data also to be included.

nodes.title: Mass and balance
nodes.definition: Those sub-assemblies or components on the Product dedicated to the specific function of recording, storing or computing mass and balance data.

nodes.title: Leveling
nodes.definition: Those instructions necessary to prepare the Product for leveling and the leveling procedure. Includes information on the leveling equipment used.

nodes.title: Weighing
nodes.definition: Those instructions necessary to prepare the Product for weighing and the weighing procedure. Includes information on the weighing equipment used. To include limits of variation allowed between physical recorded mass and calculated mass based and specific Product record.

nodes.title: Mass and c.g. data
nodes.definition: Mass and moment or index information characteristic of the Product, limitations, datum points and lines, center of gravity, range, mass and balance management of the fuel and other expendable loads, residual fuel, ballast and the effects of role change. Can include: - Expression of c.g. as a percentage of Mean Aerodynamic Chord (MAC) - Diagram of c.g. envelope and equipment location charts if necessary - Effect on the c.g. position of dropping or picking up stores (with an example) Relevant equipment included in the basic mass, plus variable equipment (ie, "role" or "fit-list" equipment), tabulated and showing mass, load arm and moment or index of each item. Relationship between the Product and ECU datum lines including the jet pipe and/or propeller datum lines and the effect of an ECU change (with a worked example).

nodes.title: Static stability
nodes.definition: Information detailing the static stability limits of the Product. Can include information required to determine the minimum nose wheel reaction necessary to ensure that the Product is stable about its main wheels whilst being moved and whilst static during servicing operations, and to ensure the Product remains stable during jacking operations. Can include tabular and graphical data for the calculation of nose wheel reaction in relation to Product mass and residual moment for both a fully equipped Product and for situations where items of equipment/stores have been removed or the fuel state is outside the normal sequence. Safety precautions and limitations cover de-fueling sequences, maximum movement speeds and movement on gradients or over rough ground.

nodes.title: Handling and maneuvering
nodes.definition: Those instructions necessary to handle and taxi the Product. Illustrations showing the location of attachment points, turning radius, etc, are included. Includes those maintenance procedures necessary to prepare the Product for handling and taxiing.

nodes.title: Handling
nodes.definition: Those instructions necessary to tow, winch or handle the Product in normal or other conditions such as towing and handling with engines removed, berthing sea vessels, etc. It includes the equipment and materials required such as tow bars, steering arms, towing cables/bridles, etc, safety precautions and limitations.

nodes.title: Maneuvering
nodes.definition: Those instructions necessary to maneuver or taxi the Product in normal or abnormal conditions such as adverse weather conditions, etc. It includes procedures to be used such as use of engines, interphone and brakes, ground turning techniques, etc; safety precautions and limitations such as exhaust danger areas, minimum turning radius, friction coefficients for various ground conditions, etc.

nodes.title: Parking, mooring, storing and return to service
nodes.definition: This System is to contain the necessary information to park, moor and/or store the Product in all conditions to which it can be subjected. Where appropriate, it is to include the procedures to prepare for parking, mooring and storing and any related return to service requirements. Illustrations, where appropriate, are to show, for example, locations of any fixing or mooring points and any controls used in the parking/mooring and storing procedure.

nodes.title: Parking
nodes.definition: Information necessary to park the Product in all weather conditions, where parking is considered as a routine short-term activity (eg, overnight, over-weekend) performed on a serviceable Product (ie, where return to service can normally be expected to be accomplished by a standard pre-operation check). Includes equipment required.

nodes.title: Mooring
nodes.definition: Information necessary to moor the Product under all weather conditions, where mooring is considered as a long or short term activity whose purpose is to tie down or otherwise secure the unit. Must also include information such as special techniques applicable to ballasting, installation and use of special support equipment applicable to mooring (eg, installation of tie-down rings to strong points) precautions and limits for the safety of the Product in high wind conditions, etc.

nodes.title: Storing
nodes.definition: Information necessary to store the Product in normal or abnormal conditions under all weather conditions, where storing is considered as a non-operational period of long or short term duration in excess of that defined for parking. It includes all appropriate inspection and preventive maintenance to safeguard structural and system integrity during storage. Where applicable, a stored Product can also be moored. Mooring during storage is covered under Section -20, not integrated within Section -30. This includes equipment required. It also includes information concerning, but not limited to: − techniques for entry into and removal from storage (eg, cleaning and inhibition/de-inhibition), fluid system draining/replenishing, static grounding, protective blanking, etc − timescales for routine in-storage maintenance such as wheel rotation, pressure checks, engine running, etc − procedures or techniques uniquely applicable to long or short term storage (project-defined terms) − preparation of the Product after storage and return to service.

nodes.title: Return to Service
nodes.definition: Those instructions necessary to prepare the Product for operation following mooring, parking or a period of storage.

nodes.title: Placards and markings
nodes.definition: All procurable placards, labels, etc, is included in the Illustrated Parts Catalog. They are illustrated, showing the part number, legend and location. The maintenance publications must provide the approximate location (eg, FWD UPPER RH) and illustrate each placard, label, marking, self-illuminating sign, etc, required for safety information, maintenance significant information or by government regulations. Those required by government regulations are so identified.

nodes.title: Exterior color schemes and markings
nodes.definition: The specifications and requirements covering Product exterior color schemes and markings.

nodes.title: Exterior placards and markings
nodes.definition: Those placards and markings required for ground servicing instructions, inspections, cautions, warnings, etc.

nodes.title: Interior placards and markings
nodes.definition: Those placards, markings self-illuminating signs, etc, required for interior general and emergency information, instructions, cautions, warnings, etc.

nodes.title: Servicing
nodes.definition: Those instructions for the replenishment and depletion of fluids, scheduled and unscheduled servicing, applicable to the whole Product. The information is concise and preferably in tabular or chart form. Precautions to be observed in servicing a particular container (eg, tank, reservoir, bottle, LOX converter, tire) such as grounding and prevention of fire hazards, is clearly stated. A diagram showing the location of regular and emergency servicing points is included. "No-step" areas or walkways, with necessary precautions, are indicated.

nodes.title: Replenishing and depleting
nodes.definition: Those instructions necessary for the replenishment or depletion of fluids. Container capacities in US, imperial and SI units of measure are included. ANA or other standard specification number and grade (if applicable) of fuel, oil, fluid, and other material used are given. Specifications and grades should be shown grouped on one page to facilitate revisions. For fuel, give expansion volume, total fuel capacity, sump capacity, net fuel capacity (as applicable) for each tank. For oil give allowance for expansion.

nodes.title: Scheduled servicing
nodes.definition: Those instructions necessary to carry out servicing that can be scheduled. Includes instructions such as those for periodic lubrication of components, radioactivity decontamination, Product external and internal cleaning, etc. It does not include lubrication procedures required for the accomplishment of maintenance practices.

nodes.title: Unscheduled servicing
nodes.definition: Those instructions necessary to carry out servicing that is normally unscheduled. Includes instructions such as those for ice and snow removal from parked Product.

nodes.title: Product loading and offloading
nodes.definition: This System contains those procedures and illustrations necessary to load and offload internal and external stores and munitions and cargo. The System also contains information on the support equipment and special tools required. Cross-references are made to applicable systems for information on the Product attachment points, pylons and carriers.

nodes.title: Support equipment
nodes.definition: A list of all support equipment and special tools, also information and illustrations as necessary on those items not covered in other documentation.

nodes.title: Cargo
nodes.definition: Examples of loading and offloading techniques, interior layout, floor loadings, location and strength of lashing points, methods of stowing and securing, capacities and dimensions of compartment and doors.

nodes.title: Internal and external stores
nodes.definition: A list of stores carried and the carrier/adapter on which they are fitted.

nodes.title: Basic information
nodes.definition: Includes the basic information on internal and external stores.

nodes.title: Supplementary information
nodes.definition: Includes any supplementary information on internal and external stores.

nodes.title: Loading procedures
nodes.definition: Includes the loading procedures for internal and external stores.

nodes.title: Offloading procedures
nodes.definition: Includes the offloading procedures for internal and external stores.

nodes.title: Loading and offloading procedures checklists
nodes.definition: Includes the checklists for loading and offloading of internal and external stores.

nodes.title: Non-nuclear munitions
nodes.definition: A list of the non-nuclear munitions (eg, rockets, missiles, bombs, ammunition) and the carrier/adapter on which they are fitted.

nodes.title: Basic information
nodes.definition: Includes the basic information on non-nuclear munitions.

nodes.title: Supplementary information
nodes.definition: Includes any supplementary information on non-nuclear munitions.

nodes.title: Loading procedures
nodes.definition: Includes the loading procedures for non-nuclear munitions.

nodes.title: Offloading procedures
nodes.definition: Includes the offloading procedures for non-nuclear munitions.

nodes.title: Loading and offloading procedures checklists
nodes.definition: Includes the checklists for loading and offloading for non-nuclear munitions.

nodes.title: Integrated combat turnaround procedures
nodes.definition: Includes information on integrated combat turnaround procedures.

nodes.title: Integrated combat turnaround procedures checklists
nodes.definition: Includes the checklists for integrated combat turnaround procedures.

nodes.title: Cross servicing checklists
nodes.definition: Includes the checklists for cross servicing for non-nuclear munitions.

nodes.title: Nuclear munitions
nodes.definition: A list of the nuclear munitions and the carrier/adapter on which they are fitted.

nodes.title: Crew information
nodes.definition: This System provides all specific information given to crew for performing all the designed missions of the Product. Description and function of the Product systems, system controls and installed equipment are included only to the extent that the information is essential to crew/operators and is not covered in the relevant system (21 and up). Note Sub-subsystem 15-04, 15-05 and 15-06 are used for breaking down the information for land and sea systems. Refer to Chap 5.2.3.1 and Chap 5.2.3.2.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This section contains an introduction which gives a general overview of the salient features of the Product.

nodes.title: Aircraft release/operating limitations
nodes.definition: This section contains all limitations that must be observed throughout the cleared operating envelope.

nodes.title: Operational characteristics
nodes.definition: This section contains a comprehensive description of the operational characteristics of the Product including both those advantageous and those undesirable.

nodes.title: Normal procedures
nodes.definition: This section contains in narrative and/or checklist form all normal procedures required to accomplish operation. Procedures for special conditions such as scramble or missions requiring intermediate operational stops re included. This section also contains the handling of installed equipment, which is not satisfactorily covered in the systems with regard to crew.

nodes.title: Emergency procedures
nodes.definition: This section contains in narrative and/or checklists form the procedures to be followed to meet any emergency that could reasonably be expected.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Includes general information on crew/operator emergency procedures.

nodes.title: Ground emergencies
nodes.definition: Includes information on crew/operator ground based emergency procedures.

nodes.title: Initialization emergencies
nodes.definition: Includes information on crew/operator initialization emergency procedures.

nodes.title: System related emergencies
nodes.definition: Includes information on crew/operator system related emergency procedures.

nodes.title: Single or multi-engine failures
nodes.definition: Includes information on crew/operator single or multi-engine emergency failure procedures.

nodes.title: Arrival/Disembarking emergencies
nodes.definition: Includes information on crew/operator arrival/disembarking emergencies.

nodes.title: Control system failures
nodes.definition: Includes information on control system failures.

nodes.title: Other emergencies or failures
nodes.definition: Includes information on other emergencies or failures.

nodes.title: Multi-function display readouts giving emergency information
nodes.definition: Includes information on crew/operator multi-function display related emergencies.

nodes.title: Special conditions
nodes.definition: This section contains information pertaining to the operation of the Product under special conditions (eg, adverse weather and climatic conditions).

nodes.title: Performance data
nodes.definition: This section contains the Product performance data required by the project and agreed upon in the Performance Substantiation document.

nodes.title: Role Operation/Weapon system procedures
nodes.definition: This section contains in narrative and/or checklist form all normal and reversionary procedures relating to role operation and the role/weapons systems not covered in the relevant systems (21 and up). All relevant safety requirements must be specified.

nodes.title: Configuration
nodes.definition: This section contains the various stores configurations, including weapons and fuel tanks, carried both internally and externally and should include details of the effect on weight, drag index, limitations.

nodes.title: Change of role
nodes.definition: Those instructions necessary to change the Product from one role to another.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: List of the primary and secondary roles of the Product, and the role equipment to be removed/installed, presented in tabular format.

nodes.title: Role changes
nodes.definition: Individual procedures to cover all changes from any one role to any other role including any necessary testing.

nodes.title: Vibration and noise analysis and attenuation
nodes.definition: This System provides the necessary information to enable operators to monitor and diagnose vibration and noise levels in order to identify imbalance, damage or misalignment in the Product dynamic and structural components. It also includes those Product and components which furnish a means of automatically controlling and/or reducing the force and/or value of the levels of vibration and/or noise within the Product through the use of active or passive systems/equipment.

nodes.title: Vibration analysis
nodes.definition: Those instructions necessary to monitor, measure, diagnose and locate sources of vibration in dynamic and structural components.

nodes.title: Noise analysis
nodes.definition: Those instructions necessary to monitor, measure, diagnose and locate sources of noise in dynamic and structural components.

nodes.title: Active attenuation/actuation
nodes.definition: That portion of the system which from a power source ensures distribution to the system and provides a physical means of reducing vibration. Included are items such as actuating mechanisms, control valves, motors, plumbing, etc.

nodes.title: Sensing
nodes.definition: Those sub-assemblies or components which provide a means of detecting vibration levels and conveying information to the control computing or indicating systems. Includes items such as accelerometers.

nodes.title: Control/computing
nodes.definition: Those Product or components used for processing data, from multiple sources, employed to activate and control attenuation systems. Includes items such as computers, switches, etc.

nodes.title: Passive attenuation
nodes.definition: Those Product and components which provide a means of passive attenuation. Includes items such as vibration absorbers, suspension bars, etc.

nodes.title: Voltage, current and resistance measuring and indicating
nodes.definition: Includes voltage, current and resistance measuring, voltage leakage, short circuit, continuity and cable testing and multimeters.

nodes.title: Standing wave ratio and impedance measuring
nodes.definition: Includes standing wave ratio, impedance and related parameter measuring.

nodes.title: Waveform measuring and analyzing
nodes.definition: Includes oscillographs, oscilloscopes, synchroscopes, waveform and spectrum analyzing.

nodes.title: Power and mechanical energy measuring
nodes.definition: Includes electrical power measuring (including metered loads), radiated (non-cabled) and mechanical power measuring.

nodes.title: Intensity measuring
nodes.definition: Includes mechanical force, sound and light measuring, motion, displacement, impact, electric and magnetic field detecting and measuring, infrared, ultraviolet, X and nuclear radiation detecting and measuring.

nodes.title: Acceleration, velocity, rate, frequency and time measuring and counting
nodes.definition: Includes acceleration, velocity, rate and mechanical frequency measuring, electrical frequency measuring and indicating, mechanical and electrical counting, reference time, elapsed time and duration measuring and interval measuring (chronoscopes).

nodes.title: Optical measuring, testing and aligning
nodes.definition: Includes collimation and similar optical measuring, spectroscopic, spectrographic and microscopic testing, photographic measuring and testing.

nodes.title: Material measuring and testing
nodes.definition: Includes physical dimension, weight, density, volume, pressure, stress and strain, tension and compression, static and dynamic balance measuring, shock testing, solid, liquid and gas analysis.

nodes.title: Multifunction measuring and testing (excludes engines and missile systems but includes most test sets)
nodes.definition: Includes electronic, electrical, mechanical and hydraulic systems and components testing, circuit board, circuit card, electron tube, semiconductor, relay, selsyn, synchro, etc testing.

nodes.title: Standards and calibration equipment for measuring and testing
nodes.definition: Includes calibration equipment for voltage, current and resistance measuring devices, SWR, impedance and related parameters, waveform measuring and analyzing devices, power, mechanical energy and intensity measuring devices, velocity, frequency and time measuring devices, optical devices, material measuring and testing devices.

nodes.title: Active devices for test purposes (excludes most test sets)
nodes.definition: Includes transducers, active filters, active mixers and modulators, active couplings matching and distribution devices, test amplifiers, active terminations and dummy loads.

nodes.title: Passive devices for test purposes (excludes most test sets)
nodes.definition: Includes variable resistors and unqualified variable attenuators, variable capacitors, variable inductances, passive electrical coupling matching and distribution devices (including fixed attenuators and most dividers and probes), passive electromagnetic and electro-static coupling, matching and distribution devices (including inductive voltage dividers and probes), mounting devices and passive mechanical coupling devices, passive filters, passive delay devices, passive non-power measuring terminations and dummy loads, passive mixer, modulator and detectors.

nodes.title: Nondestructive inspection and oil analysis
nodes.definition: Includes fluorescent penetrant, magnetic particle, X-ray, ultrasonic, eddy current, oil analysis and acoustic emission.

nodes.title: Signal and power generating, supplying, storing and converting (excludes transducers)
Signal generating
nodes.definition: Includes AM/FM pulse-modulated, audio, sweep, square-wave, triangular-wave, saw tooth etc generators, random noise and noise generators and waveform synthesizers.

nodes.title: Electrical power supplying, generating, storing and converting
nodes.definition: Includes electrical generators, converters, inverters, dynamotors, power supplies and battery chargers, transformers and distribution networks.

nodes.title: Mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic and vacuum power supplying, storing and converting
nodes.definition: Includes mechanical power supplying, storage and converting (including motors, turbines etc), general purpose compressing and pumping, hydraulic and pneumatic power and vacuum generating and storing, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic and vacuum devices (including those which also supply power).

nodes.title: Communicating (excludes headsets, loudspeakers, etc)
nodes.definition: Includes intercommunication systems, public address systems, non-airborne and airborne multifunction and special purpose communication devices.

nodes.title: Signaling
nodes.definition: Includes signal lights, mechanical signaling devices and special purpose signaling devices.

nodes.title: Lighting
nodes.definition: Includes area, search, marking and identification lighting and special purpose lighting.

nodes.title: Engine and missile system checkout and testing
Engine checkout and testing
nodes.definition: Includes automotive engine, air vehicle engine and missile engine testing and general and special purpose engine testing. Note: This code is also applicable to engine modules and accessories.

nodes.title: Missile system checkout and testing
nodes.definition: Includes missile guidance, missile target or flight programming, missile telemetering and training, missile hydraulic, pneumatic and fuel systems checkout, miscellaneous missiles system checkout and testing and missile countdown equipment.

nodes.title: Gas and liquid supplying, processing, storing and shipping
Gas storage, processing, supplying and shipping
nodes.definition: Includes gas storage containers, gas storage processing, supplying and shipping equipment and vehicles and multipurpose and special purpose gas handling equipment.

nodes.title: Liquid storage, processing, supplying and shipping
nodes.definition: Includes liquid storage containers, liquid storage, processing, supplying and shipping equipment and vehicles and multipurpose and special purpose liquid handling equipment.

nodes.title: Shelters and chambers
nodes.definition: Includes personnel and maintenance shelters, test chambers and test shelters, special purpose and multipurpose shelters and chambers.

nodes.title: Protective deflectors, shields, screens and coverings
nodes.definition: Includes deflectors, shields, screens, protective coverings, miscellaneous protective equipment.

nodes.title: Supports for shoring and shipping
nodes.definition: Includes supports for storing and shipping.

nodes.title: Special purpose and multipurpose devices
nodes.definition: Includes special purpose and multipurpose devices.

nodes.title: Flight clothing and accessories
nodes.definition: Includes flight clothing and accessories.

nodes.title: General mechanical cleaning, degreasing and scaling
nodes.definition: Includes pressure and vacuum cleaners, spray cleaners and degreasers, scalars, special purpose and multipurpose cleaning devices.

nodes.title: Deicing and decontaminating
nodes.definition: Includes deicing and decontaminating equipment.

nodes.title: Road and runway cleaning and repairing
nodes.definition: Includes road and runway cleaning and repairing, combination and special purpose road and runway cleaning and repairing and associated devices.

nodes.title: Lubricating
nodes.definition: Includes oiling and greasing equipment and special purpose lubricating equipment.

nodes.title: Wheel, tire and mechanical system servicing
nodes.definition: Includes wheel and tire servicing, brake, hydraulic and pneumatic systems servicing and special purpose and multipurpose mechanical system servicing.

nodes.title: Special purpose and multipurpose servicing
nodes.definition: Includes maintenance tool sets, kits and machines, repair kits, maintenance trailers, welding machines, purging units, spray outfit preservation units, etc.

nodes.title: Maintenance platform, stands, supports and accessories
nodes.definition: Includes maintenance platforms and stands for personnel, equipment supports, weapon and special purpose supports and maintenance accessories.

nodes.title: Special machines
nodes.definition: Includes maintenance tools, (eg, extractors, guiders, stackers, specific spanners) and also other means such as complex machines/parts interfaces.

nodes.title: Handling, moving, stopping, propelling and landing
Hoisting, jacking, lifting, towing and positioning
nodes.definition: Includes hoisting, lifting, jacking, erecting and towing equipment and special purpose and multipurpose lifting and positioning equipment.

nodes.title: Transporting of equipment and solid material
nodes.definition: Includes powered trucks and tractors, hand trucks, carts, dollies, trailers, transporting vehicles and devices, accessory equipment for transporting, delivery and recovery systems, tires and tubes.

nodes.title: Launching
nodes.definition: Includes air vehicle, guided missile, rocket and space vehicles launching equipment and special purpose and multipurpose launching equipment.

nodes.title: Arresting, parking and securing
nodes.definition: Includes auxiliary braking, emergency braking and arresting, securing, checking, looking and parking and similar storing.

nodes.title: Special purpose and multipurpose handling and moving
nodes.definition: Includes combined lifting and moving vehicles and equipment (trailers, dollies and cradles for air vehicle equipment and components handing, installation, removal, transportation and storage; handling adapter sets; trailers for ammunition lifting and transportation; trucks for loading munitions, fuel tanks, pylons and special weapons onto air vehicles, etc).

nodes.title: Propulsion system
nodes.definition: Includes rocket engines, motors and hybrids, reciprocating engines, turbine engines and miscellaneous engines and components.

nodes.title: Heating, cooling, ventilating, humidity control, pressurizing and filtering
Heating
nodes.definition: Includes area heating equipment and special purpose and multipurpose heating equipment.

nodes.title: Air cooling and air conditioning
nodes.definition: Includes air cooling and air conditioning equipment and special purpose and multipurpose cooling equipment.

nodes.title: Ventilating and air circulating
nodes.definition: Includes ventilating and air circulating and special purpose and multipurpose ventilating and air conditioning equipment.

nodes.title: Humidity controlling
nodes.definition: Includes humidity reducing, humidity increasing, constant humidity equipment and special purpose and multipurpose humidity controlling equipment.

nodes.title: Refrigerating
nodes.definition: Includes general purpose refrigerating equipment and special purpose and multipurpose pressurizing equipment.

nodes.title: Multipurpose and special purpose equipment
nodes.definition: Includes multipurpose and special purpose heating, cooling, ventilating and humidity control equipment.

nodes.title: Pressurizing
nodes.definition: Includes compartment pressurizing and special purpose and multipurpose pressurizing equipment.

nodes.title: Water cooling
nodes.definition: Includes engine cooling systems and components and special purpose and multipurpose water cooling equipment.

nodes.title: Filtering
nodes.definition: Includes pneumatic and liquid filtering and special purpose and multipurpose filtering equipment.

nodes.title: Fire fighting, crash and rescue equipment
nodes.definition: Includes fire fighting, crash, rescue equipment and special purpose and multipurpose fire fighting, crash and rescue equipment.

nodes.title: Survival equipment and devices
nodes.definition: Includes survival tools and accessories, survival vehicles and special purpose and multipurpose survival items.

nodes.title: Pilot and flight crew flight simulators
nodes.definition: Includes basic flight and advanced flight simulator trainers, instrument, flight trainers and mobile training units.

nodes.title: Ground crew training flight simulators
nodes.definition: Includes flight principle trainers, flight control, navigation, warning indicator instrument system trainers, mechanical and electrical systems trainers, engine operation and maintenance trainers, aircraft servicing equipment trainers and mobile training units.

nodes.title: Armament trainers
nodes.definition: Includes stationary airborne gunnery, free airborne gunnery, airborne rocketry, high altitude bombing, ground support bombing, armament components and multipurpose armament trainers and mobile training units.

nodes.title: Navigation trainers
nodes.definition: Includes dead-reckoning, celestial, electronic and crew navigation trainers, mobile and aerospace navigation training units.

nodes.title: Radar and communications trainers
nodes.definition: Includes primary and advanced communications equipment trainers, primary and advanced radar equipment trainers and radar countermeasures trainers.

nodes.title: Psychological and psycho-physiological trainers
nodes.definition: Includes low pressure chambers, ejection seat trainers, underwater escape trainers and other survival procedures, space environment and vertigo simulator trainers.

nodes.title: Ground-to-ground and ground-to-air missile trainers
nodes.definition: Includes ground crew, missile operation and maintenance trainers, launch control and flight control equipment trainers.

nodes.title: Special project trainers
nodes.definition: Includes synthetic warfare tactics trainers and combat information centers equipment trainers.

nodes.title: Training aids
nodes.definition: Includes charts and posters, maneuvering boards and demonstrator panels, self instruction cards, training manuals, three-dimensional models, projectors, sound recorders and reproducers, training films and recordings and miscellaneous classroom teaching aids.

nodes.title: Command training programs (tangible items)
nodes.definition: Includes service-school training programs and activity training programs.

nodes.title: Miscellaneous training and simulating devices
nodes.definition: Includes automotive and airfield training devices, simulators for material testing, hydraulic, pneumatic, oxygen, fuel, air systems training, dummy guided missiles, simulated bombs for test aid training purposes, training dummy or practice warhead and aircraft simulated rockets.

nodes.title: Detecting, range bearing and search
nodes.definition: Includes transmitting, receiving, designating, indicating and locating equipment.

nodes.title: Directing
nodes.definition: Includes computing sights and devices, optical sighting and ranging, stabilizing mechanisms and transmitting and receiving equipment.

nodes.title: Miscellaneous fire control
nodes.definition: Includes fuse setters, ordnance cable system, aiming circles, flash and round ranging sets.

nodes.title: Guns
nodes.definition: Includes air vehicle and non air vehicle guns, ammunition feeders, loaders, storage drums, etc.

nodes.title: Ammunition
nodes.definition: Includes dummy or blank ammunition, tracer projectiles, live or special purpose ammunition.

nodes.title: Bombs, rockets and missiles
nodes.definition: Includes photo flashing, chemical warfare, general purpose, practice, guided or drones bombs and rockets and warheads and explosive components.

nodes.title: Automatic flight or remote control
nodes.definition: Includes guided missiles and spaces vehicles.

nodes.title: Navigation
nodes.definition: Includes airborne and non airborne direction finding equipment.

nodes.title: Engine ignition system
nodes.definition: Includes air vehicle and non air vehicle ignition systems.

nodes.title: Special ignition systems
nodes.definition: Includes special purpose and multipurpose ignition systems.

nodes.title: Picture taking equipment
nodes.definition: Includes strike recording, aerial mapping, still and motion pictures.

nodes.title: Picture processing equipment
nodes.definition: Includes processing mechanisms, developers, washers and driers.

nodes.title: Picture using equipment
nodes.definition: Includes still projectors, motion picture projectors and viewing devices.

nodes.title: Analog computing
nodes.definition: Includes all analog computing devices.

nodes.title: Digital computing
nodes.definition: Includes all digital computing devices.

nodes.title: Hybrid computing
nodes.definition: Includes all computing equipment that is a hybrid of analog and digital.

nodes.title: Input/output and storage
nodes.definition: Includes all input and out devices such as keyboards, mice, displays, projectors, flash cards, hard disks and other storage media.

nodes.title: Collating, reading and interpreting
nodes.definition: Includes cameras and scanners.

nodes.title: Special purpose equipment
nodes.definition: Includes special purpose and multipurpose data processing equipment.

nodes.title: Propulsion, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment for producing and delivering power, to move/position the launcher.

nodes.title: Power unit, General
nodes.definition: The power unit element refers to a discrete means for generating and delivering power for maneuvering the ordnance system in the battlefield. It can include, for example, flywheel and clutch assemblies.

nodes.title: Engine
nodes.definition: Refers to a diesel, petrol, electric, etc fuelled means for generating power and a means whereby this power can be delivered to the transmission. It can include, for example, flywheel and clutch assemblies and engine mounted cooling, fuel, air and exhaust, lubrication, auxiliary and electrical systems.

nodes.title: Cooling system
nodes.definition: Refers to systems designed to maintain the correct operating temperatures for the power unit. It includes, for example, cooling air ducting, coolant pumps, liquid filled radiators, intercoolers, fans and associated heat exchange equipment.

nodes.title: Fuel systems
nodes.definition: Refers to a system or equipment designed to deliver fuel to the power unit. It includes, for example, fuel storage facilities, pumps, filters, delivery pipes, drainage and cut-off valves, Fuel Injector Pumps (FIP) and injectors.

nodes.title: Air and exhaust systems
nodes.definition: Refers to a system which supplies air to, or collects and removes exhaust gasses from the engine. It includes, for example, all pipes, ducting, filters, couplings, gaskets, turbochargers/superchargers, silencers and catalytic converters.

nodes.title: Lubrication systems
nodes.definition: Refers to a system that provides lubrication to the power unit and any external components related to the power unit lubrication system. It includes, for example, delivery and return pipes, pumps, filters, intercoolers and separately mounted heat exchangers.

nodes.title: Electrical
nodes.definition: Refers to a system that provides or uses electrical power associated with the power unit. It includes, for example, starter motors, alternators and generators directly mounted on the power unit. It also includes, for example, ignition system components including spark plugs, distributor, coils and leads.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls, items and associated systems in, or directly mounted on, the power unit. It includes, for example, engine mountings.

nodes.title: Hydraulic
nodes.definition: Refers to a system that provides or uses hydraulic power associated with the power unit. It includes, for example, hydraulic pumps, valves, pipes, and tanks. It also includes any external components related to the power unit hydraulic systems.

nodes.title: Transmission, General
nodes.definition: Refers to a means to transmit power from the engine to the driving member and can include clutch, torque converter, gearbox. It can also include steering and brakes if they are integral to the transmission. Also included are differentials and power takeoffs.

nodes.title: Gearbox
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for varying the speed/torque delivered from the power unit to the driving member. It can include the steering control and brake assemblies.

nodes.title: Steering control assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to a discrete means for varying the drive applied, through the transmission system, to each of the launcher's driving members.

nodes.title: Brake assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to a discrete means for applying braking forces through the launcher transmission system.

nodes.title: Auxiliary drive/power takeoff
nodes.definition: Refers to an auxiliary means of obtaining an output from the engine. It includes transfer gearboxes which can also include a slip differential.

nodes.title: Clutch
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for engaging/disengaging the transmission to/from the engine, when fitted as a separate assembly.

nodes.title: Drive shaft
nodes.definition: Refers to the means for connecting power output from the engine to the driving member. It includes muff couplings, universal joints, chains, belts and final drives.

nodes.title: Torque converter
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for varying the torque delivered from the engine to the driving member.

nodes.title: Differential
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for changing the direction of rotation delivered from the engine to the driving member or wheels.

nodes.title: Automotive/remote piloting and digital control systems, General
Automotive/remote piloting and digital control systems, General
nodes.definition: The automotive and remote piloting and Digital Automotive Control System (DACS) element refers to that equipment (hardware/software) installed in the launcher which is used to plan and control its speed and direction either autonomously or via tele-operation. This includes equipment which senses, processes and displays imagery data such as stereo vision systems, laser scanners, multiple sensor fusion algorithms and processors, image enhancement algorithms and processors etc. This includes, for example, equipment which performs intelligence analysis and planning functions such as automated route planners, image understanding algorithms and processors, computer aided driving algorithms, DACS and processors.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to processing and control elements. It includes central processors, analogue/digital converters, associated software, memory boards, servo units, actuators, associated wiring, etc.

nodes.title: Sensors
nodes.definition: Refers to sensors which are specifically associated with providing inputs to an automotive/remote piloting system or DACS.

nodes.title: Indicators
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used to indicate/ monitor an automotive/remote piloting system or DACS. It includes indicators, wiring, etc.

nodes.title: Controls (drivers), General
nodes.definition: Given in this element are the controls required to start, stop, steer and generally control the launcher, commensurate with the mobility role of the equipment. It includes, for example, on-board diagnostic systems.

nodes.title: Foot controls
nodes.definition: Refers to the foot-operated controls to start, stop, steer and generally control the launcher. It includes, for example, pedal assemblies (clutch, brake, accelerator, etc), associated linkages, cables, hydraulic/pneumatic connections, master and slave cylinders, brake shoes and pads and disks and drums.

nodes.title: Hand controls
nodes.definition: Refers to the hand-operated controls to start, stop, steer and generally control the launcher. It includes, for example, stop/start, steering (wheel, tiller, etc) and braking controls.

nodes.title: Ancillary controls
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls and associated systems. It includes, for example, such items as screen wash equipment, windscreen wipers and adjustable wing mirrors.

nodes.title: Propulsion control systems
nodes.definition: Refers to systems which monitor and/or control engine speed and performance.

nodes.title: Instrumentation
nodes.definition: Refers to systems (hardware/software) which monitor/ report on the operation of launcher systems. It includes, for example, the driver’s instrumentation panel, warning lights and condition monitoring systems.

nodes.title: Launcher propulsion, General
nodes.definition: The launcher propulsion element provides the forces to expel the complete round from the launcher to the target. It does not include propulsion provided by the projectile.

nodes.title: Chemical
nodes.definition: Refers to the chemical launch element.

nodes.title: Mechanical
nodes.definition: Refers to the mechanical launch element.

nodes.title: Electrical
nodes.definition: Refers to the electrical launch element, including magnetic propulsion systems.

nodes.title: Pneumatic
nodes.definition: Refers to the pneumatic launch element.

nodes.title: Projectile propulsion, General
nodes.definition: The projectile propulsion element provides the forces to transport the complete round from the launch position to the target. For artillery ammunition this element includes the cartridge case and if applicable the primer as well as the explosive charge itself. It does not include propulsion

nodes.title: Chemical
nodes.definition: Refers to the chemical projectile propulsion element, including such devices as chemical precision initiation charges.

nodes.title: Mechanical
nodes.definition: Refers to the mechanical projectile propulsion element.

nodes.title: Electrical
nodes.definition: Refers to the electrical projectile propulsion element. It includes such devices as electric power charges.

nodes.title: Pneumatic
nodes.definition: Refers to the pneumatic projectile propulsion element.

nodes.title: Rocket motor
nodes.definition: Refers to the rocket motor projectile propulsion element.

nodes.title: Structure, General
nodes.definition: Framework and/or basic structural housing for a system, including load bearing components.

nodes.title: Frame/carriage/trail legs General
nodes.definition: The frame/carriage/trail legs element refers to the primary load bearing components of the launcher which provide the structural integrity to withstand operational loading stresses generated whilst in use, for example when traversing various terrain profiles. This element applies to firing posts, wheeled frames, etc. It does not apply to hand-held weapons. It includes all structural subassemblies and appendages which attach directly to the primary structure. This element, for example, includes towing and lifting fittings, bumpers, hatches and grilles. It also includes provision to accommodate other subsystems such as mountings for suspension, weapons, turret, track body, cab, special equipment, loads etc.

nodes.title: Frame/firing post
nodes.definition: Refers to the basic structural housing for a non-wheeled ordnance system, including load bearing components, recoil mechanisms, mountings, firing platforms, stays, fittings and fixtures.

nodes.title: Carriage
nodes.definition: Refers to the basic structural housing for a wheeled ordnance system, including load bearing components, recoil mechanisms, mountings, towing assemblies, fittings and fixtures.

nodes.title: Trail legs/spades
nodes.definition: Refers to trail legs and spades provided to ensure launch platform stability during firing. They can also be used for towing.

nodes.title: Traverse/elevation mechanism
nodes.definition: Refers to elevating/ traversing mechanisms (manual or powered) and their associated systems/components directly mounted on the frame/carriage/trail legs.

nodes.title: Armor
nodes.definition: Refers to protective amour and associated components directly mounted on the frame/carriage/trail legs.

nodes.title: Ammunition storage
nodes.definition: Refers to ammunition storage facilities and associated components directly mounted on the frame/carriage/trail legs.

nodes.title: Seats
nodes.definition: Refers to seating which is directly mounted on the frame/carriage/trail legs.

nodes.title: Suspension/wheels, General
nodes.definition: The suspension/track/wheels element refers to the means for providing mobility or generating tractive effort, thrust and lift, generally at or in proximity to the earth's surface and adapting the launcher to the irregularities of the surface. It includes, for example, wheels and steering gears for traction and control functions. Also, it includes springs, shock absorbers, braking mechanisms, and other suspension members.

nodes.title: Suspension unit
nodes.definition: Refers to the means for adapting the launcher to irregularities of the surface. It includes shock absorbers, leaf and coil springs, pneumatic suspension units, etc.

nodes.title: Axle
nodes.definition: Refers to axle assemblies. It includes, for example, axle arms, links, torsion arms, bearings, wheels that transfer tractive effort to the surface and rolling wheels, hub assemblies, tires, valves, inner-tubes, brake drums, pads, slave cylinders and discs.

nodes.title: Braking assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for preventing un-planned movement of the ordnance system, not integral to the axle assembly. It includes, for example, hydraulic master cylinders, pipes, cables, over-run braking systems and hand brakes.

nodes.title: Projectile structure, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the portion of the complete round which carries the payload to the target. It includes the casing of a projectile, the housing of a bomb and the body of a torpedo.

nodes.title: Projectile casing
nodes.definition: Refers to the basic casing of the projectile. It includes those structural devices which provide stability (eg, fins).

nodes.title: Bomb housing
nodes.definition: Refers to the basic housing of the bomb. It includes those structural devices which provide power, stability and control (eg, fins, parachutes, anchors, batteries).

nodes.title: Torpedo body
nodes.definition: Refers to the basic housing of the torpedo. It includes those structural devices which provide power, stability and control (eg, fins, parachutes, anchors, batteries).

nodes.title: Rocket housing
nodes.definition: Refers to the basic housing of the rocket. It includes those structural devices which provide power, stability and control (eg, fins, parachutes, anchors, batteries).

nodes.title: Armaments, General
nodes.definition: A defensive or offensive system or equipment.

nodes.title: Gun control systems, General
nodes.definition: The gun control element refers to that equipment (hardware/software) installed in the launcher which provides intelligence necessary to power elevate and traverse the weapons systems and also to control via stabilization systems, and gun drives, including gun position indicators and sensors.

nodes.title: Installation
nodes.definition: Refers to the Gun Control Equipment (GCE) installation.

nodes.title: Control panel
nodes.definition: Refers to control panels associated with GCE.

nodes.title: Power supply
nodes.definition: Refers to power supply units associated with GCE.

nodes.title: Switch units
nodes.definition: Refers to switch units associated with GCE. It includes trimming units, fire control switches, etc.

nodes.title: Gun controller
nodes.definition: Refers to control systems associated with GCE. It includes controls for the gun, motor generators, metadynes, amplidynes, magnicons, power amplifiers.

nodes.title: Power motors
nodes.definition: Refers to gearbox drive motors, associated with GCE. It includes the power, elevation and traverse drive motors.

nodes.title: Gyroscope assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to gyroscope assemblies associated with GCE.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary GCE controls and associated systems. It includes such items as turnbuckle assemblies, traverse displacement units, fire control quadrants, inter-connecting boxes, wiring, connectors, etc.

nodes.title: Fire control systems, General
nodes.definition: The fire control element refers to that equipment (hardware/software) installed in the launcher which provides intelligence necessary for weapons delivery such as launching and firing. This element includes, for example, radar and other sensors necessary for search recognition, meteorological and/ or tracking; controls and displays, fire control computers, and computer programs.

nodes.title: Computer/interface
nodes.definition: Refers to computer interface systems and equipment associated with fire control systems. It includes computer/interface units, program loading facilities, etc.

nodes.title: Control/monitor
nodes.definition: Refers to control and monitoring equipment associated with the fire control systems.

nodes.title: Filter units
nodes.definition: Refers to filter units associated with the fire control systems.

nodes.title: Sensors
nodes.definition: Refers to sensors associated with the fire control systems. It includes sensors for elevation and traverse displacement, trunnion tilt, sighting angle, etc.

nodes.title: Firing handles
nodes.definition: Refers to firing handles associated with the fire control systems, including trigger mechanisms.

nodes.title: Fire control boxes
nodes.definition: Refers to control boxes associated with the fire control system. It includes the commander's, and gunner's control boxes, the loader's safety box, etc.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary items and associated systems. It includes, for example, such items as junction boxes, cables, connectors and services.

nodes.title: Thermal imaging, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to that equipment (hardware/software) which provides a thermal picture for the crew or operator to use for surveillance and weapon guidance. It includes thermal imaging sensor heads, drive units, processors, sights, power supply units, and display units.

nodes.title: Sensor
nodes.definition: Refers to sensors specifically associated with thermal imaging systems. It includes scanner head assemblies, IR telescopes, tilt sensors, focal telescopes, etc.

nodes.title: Processing
nodes.definition: Refers to processing elements associated with thermal imaging systems. It includes symbology units, processors, etc.

nodes.title: Display
nodes.definition: Refers to the display elements of a thermal imaging system. It includes binocular viewers, commander's and gunner's display units, display drive units, etc.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to the control elements of a thermal imaging system. It includes servo units, gunner's and commander's control units, etc.

nodes.title: Converter units
nodes.definition: Refers to converter elements of a thermal imaging system. It includes isolating converter units, etc.

nodes.title: Structure and framework
nodes.definition: Refers to framework and/or basic structural housing for a thermal imaging system, including load bearing components.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls, items and associated systems related to thermal imaging systems. It includes such items as wash/wipe equipment, cables, connectors, services, etc.

nodes.title: Thermal imaging cooling systems, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to that equipment which provides a cooling medium, for thermal images. It will include, for example, compressors, bottles, pipes, fans, mini coolers, air cleaning columns and stirling cycle cooling machines.

nodes.title: Compressors
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used to pressurize the cooling system. It includes motors, pumps, etc.

nodes.title: Storage
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used for storage of coolant. It includes tanks, pressurized containers, filling systems, sumps, drains, etc.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used for distribution of coolant. It includes pipes, valves, etc.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used to monitor the condition of coolant (quantity, temperature and pressure). It includes transmitters, indicators, wiring, warning systems, etc.

nodes.title: Optical sighting systems, General
nodes.definition: The optical element refers to the sighting systems for search, observation, identification, tracking, range-finding and will include sensors and displays associated with this system.

nodes.title: Surveillance
nodes.definition: Refers to optical surveillance equipment. It includes, for example, such items as observation periscopes, etc.

nodes.title: Sighting
nodes.definition: Refers to optical sighting equipment. It includes, for example, such items as sighting and aiming periscopes and iron sights.

nodes.title: Reticle image projector
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for displaying a reticle image in/on the sighting device.

nodes.title: Sighting unit
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for displaying a reticle image in the sighting device.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls, items and associated systems related to optical sighting systems. It includes such items as wash/ wipe equipment, cables, connectors, services, etc.

nodes.title: Weapon/gun, General
nodes.definition: The weapon/gun element refers to the means for the launcher to deliver fire on hostile targets or for logistics and other vehicles to exercise self-defense. This element includes, for example, the main gun/ elevating mass and secondary armaments such as small arms and mortars. Fire control, gun control, and optical systems are excluded.

nodes.title: Launcher
nodes.definition: The launcher assembly provides initial guidance for launch of projectiles. It includes, for example, barrels, tubes (mortar, torpedo, etc) and rails.

nodes.title: Breech, housing and firing mechanism
nodes.definition: Refers to a system which provides a means of access for the projectile/case to enter the barrel. It also provides a pressure seal and firing mechanism, together with the means by which the breech and firing mechanism are housed within the equipment. It includes all associated housing items.

nodes.title: Mountings
nodes.definition: Refers to the means for attaching the barrel assembly and can include the mountlet assembly as well as the means to balance the armament system. It also includes tripods and bipods.

nodes.title: Recoil mechanism
nodes.definition: Refers to systems which provide a means for absorbing energy created by projectile launch. It includes recuperator and recoil assemblies, etc.

nodes.title: Smoke discharger
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for dispersing smoke/fumes generated when a round is fired.

nodes.title: Secondary armaments installation
nodes.definition: Refers to systems which provide a secondary armaments installation.

nodes.title: Sights
nodes.definition: Refers to a mechanical sighting system used on small arms, machine guns, man-portable launchers, etc.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary items and associated systems. It includes, for example, such items as spare barrels and other parts, wallets, cleaning kits and sustained fire kits.

nodes.title: Automatic loading systems, General
nodes.definition: The automatic loading element consists of that equipment (hardware/software) providing the means to select ammunition from a stored position, its transfer to and loading of the armament system. This element also includes the means to eject spent cases and misfired rounds. Components include all ammunition storage racks, transfer/lift mechanisms, ramming and ejecting mechanisms as well as specialized hydraulic and electrical controls. It does not include storage provided externally from the main system.

nodes.title: Storage (ready round)
nodes.definition: Refers to ammunition storage racks, bins, etc.

nodes.title: Rocket pods/mine racks/dispensers
nodes.definition: Provides a means of holding/supporting the projectile during transportation, and a means of releasing the projectile.

nodes.title: Transfer/lift
nodes.definition: Refers to the means to select ammunition from a stored position in the launcher and transfer it to the armament system. It includes transfer and lift mechanisms

nodes.title: Loading/ramming
nodes.definition: Refers to the means to loading the armament system. It includes ramming and ejecting mechanisms.

nodes.title: Feed mechanism
nodes.definition: The feed mechanism element refers to the equipment for placing ammunition in a position, ready for chambering.

nodes.title: Automatic loading devices
nodes.definition: The automatic loading element consists of that equipment providing the means to select ammunition from a stored position and transferring it to a feed mechanism or ready magazine.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to the means to control loading the armament system. It includes specialized hydraulic and electrical controls and safety devices.

nodes.title: Armaments projectile, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the portion of the projectile which carries the payload to the target. It is the basic housing of the bomb or rocket, casing of the projectile, body of a torpedo or the tactical munitions dispenser containing sub-munitions. It also includes those structural devices which provide stability and control (eg, fins, parachutes, anchors).

nodes.title: Payload
nodes.definition: Payload element refers to the subsystem which contains the warhead and its support assemblies. In some munitions such as small arms and munitions, the payload can only be the warhead. With complex munitions the payload can contain sub munitions (the payload subsystem can also include discrete guidance and control, fuse, safety/armament and propulsion systems).

nodes.title: Fuse
nodes.definition: Fuse element refers to the mechanical or electronic device in the projectile designed to detonate or to set forces into action to detonate the charge or primer under desired conditions.

nodes.title: Initial safety & arming
nodes.definition: The initial safety and arming element refers to the device in the projectile which controls the capability of initiating the explosive sequence.

nodes.title: Secondary safety & arming
nodes.definition: The secondary safety and arming element refers to the device in the complete round which controls the capability of initiating the explosive sequence, should the initial safety and arming device fail.

nodes.title: Dispenser containing sub-munitions, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the portion of the projectile which carries sub-munitions to the target.

nodes.title: Tactical munitions dispenser
nodes.definition: Tactical munitions dispenser containing sub-munitions, other than those contained within the payload.

nodes.title: Electrical systems, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment for generation, distribution and/or control of electric power.

nodes.title: Launcher electrical systems, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the electrical or electronic systems for the launcher. It will include wiring harnesses, line replaceable units (LRUs), sensors, lighting, batteries, generators, etc.

nodes.title: Generating
nodes.definition: Refers to generating systems and equipment related to the launcher. It includes such items as alternators, dynamos, generator panels, etc.

nodes.title: Batteries
nodes.definition: Refers to battery equipment related to the launcher. It includes such items as battery containers, lagging kits, battery assemblies, connecting straps, etc.

nodes.title: Instrumentation
nodes.definition: Refers to instrumentation systems and equipment related to the launcher. It includes such items as tachometers, speedometers, indicating panels, electronic circuit panels, control transmitters, etc.

nodes.title: Lights
nodes.definition: Refers to lighting systems and equipment related to the launcher. It includes such items as inspection lights, etc.

nodes.title: Wiring
nodes.definition: Refers to wiring and cable looms related to the launcher. It includes looms, wires, harnesses, etc.

nodes.title: Electrical equipment
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical equipment related to the launcher. It includes, for example, actuators, engine controls and ignition systems.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical distribution systems and equipment related to the launcher. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: Protection
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical protection systems and equipment related to the launcher. It includes such items as fuses, fusible links, trip switches, etc.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to control systems and equipment related to the launcher. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: Projectile electrical systems, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the devices within the projectile which provide electrical power.

nodes.title: AC power
nodes.definition: Refers to AC power systems within the projectile (eg, generators).

nodes.title: DC power
nodes.definition: Refers to DC power systems within the projectile (eg, batteries, quartz crystal).

nodes.title: External power
nodes.definition: That portion of the system within the projectile that connects external electrical power sources (eg, battery charging points).

nodes.title: Communications, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment for transferring information.

nodes.title: Launcher communications, General
nodes.definition: The communications element refers to that equipment (hardware/ software) which provides the means within the system for commanding, controlling and transmitting/receiving information and data to launcher crews and other personnel exterior to the operating environment. This element includes radio frequency equipment, microwave and optic communication links, networked equipment for multiple launcher control and intercoms and external phones systems. It can include navigational system and data displays when these are integral with the equipment of crew stations of the turret assembly or drivers automotive display.

nodes.title: UHF/SHF/EHF
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system used for communications utilizing ultra, super and extra high frequency (UHF, SHF, EHF) carriers. It includes transmitters, receivers, control, antennas, etc.

nodes.title: VHF
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system used for communications utilizing very high frequency (VHF) carriers. It includes transmitters, receivers, control, antennas, etc.

nodes.title: HF
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system used for communications utilizing high frequency (HF) carriers. It includes transmitters, receivers, control, antennas, etc.

nodes.title: LF
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system used for communications utilizing low frequency (LF) carriers. It includes transmitters, receivers, control, antennas, etc.

nodes.title: Audio
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system used for voice communications. It includes such items as intercoms, headphones, loudspeakers, switching/control panels, etc.

nodes.title: Digital
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system used for digital/data communications. It includes modems, encryption devices, etc.

nodes.title: Satellite
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system used for communications via satellites. It includes transmitters, receivers, control, antennas, etc.

nodes.title: Optical
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system used for communications via line-of-site. It includes transmitters, receivers, control, signaling devices, etc.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls and associated systems. It includes such items as wiring, connectors, etc.

nodes.title: Launcher identification friend/foe (IFF), General
nodes.definition: IFF equipment is common to all services and is therefore interactive with many other users. It covers the equipment (hardware/software) that identifies friend or foe and transmits that information using the launcher communication system(s).

nodes.title: Transmitting
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the launcher system which is used to send data.

nodes.title: Receiving
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the launcher system which is used to receive IFF data.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the launcher system which is used to display IFF data.

nodes.title: Projectile communications, General
nodes.definition: The communications element refers to that equipment (hardware/software) which provides the means within the system for commanding, controlling and transmitting/receiving information and data to the projectile. This element includes radio frequency equipment, microwave and optical communication links and networked equipment for multiple control. It can include navigational system and data displays when these are integral with the projectile equipment.

nodes.title: LF

nodes.title: Optical

nodes.title: Ancillary

nodes.title: Projectile identification friend/foe (IFF), General
nodes.definition: IFF equipment is common to all services and is therefore interactive with many other users. It covers the equipment (hardware/software) within the projectile that identifies friend or foe.

nodes.title: Transmitting
