nodes.title: Receiving
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the launcher system which is used to receive IFF data.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the launcher system which is used to display IFF data.

nodes.title: Navigation, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to determine, conduct, manage, or plot a position or course.

nodes.title: Launcher navigation, General
nodes.definition: The navigation element refers to that equipment (hardware/software) installed in the launcher which permits the crew to determine location and to plot a course. It includes navigation systems such as dead reckoning, inertial and global positioning systems. Landmark recognition algorithms and processors are also included.

nodes.title: Independent
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system (hardware/software) which provides information to determine position and is independent on ground installations or orbiting satellites. It includes inertial guidance systems, tracking systems, sextants, etc.

nodes.title: Dependant
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system (hardware/software) which provides information to determine position and is mainly dependant on ground installations or orbiting satellites. It includes GPS, radio compass, etc.

nodes.title: Computing
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system (hardware/software) which combines/processes navigational data to compute or manage the geographical position of the launcher. It includes course computers, landmark recognition algorithms, processors, displays, etc.

nodes.title: Launcher guidance and control, General
nodes.definition: This system refers to the complex of electronic equipment/hardware/software, based on the launcher, which evaluates and correlates the path of the projectile with target information and which performs the necessary functions to enable the payload to intercept the target. This element also includes emplacement of mines.

nodes.title: Computers/software
nodes.definition: This element refers to any computational devices hardware/software associated with launcher-based guidance and control of the projectile. This element also includes emplacement of mines.

nodes.title: Control consoles
nodes.definition: This element refers to any control consoles (hardware/software), associated with launcher-based guidance and control of the projectile. This element also includes emplacement of mines.

nodes.title: Projectile guidance and control, General
nodes.definition: This system refers to the complex of electronic equipment/hardware/software which evaluates and correlates the path of the projectile with target information and which performs the necessary functions to enable the payload to intercept the target. It includes, for example, laser guided bombs.

nodes.title: Projectile built-in stability mechanisms
nodes.definition: This element refers to the control devices within the projectile which provide stability during flight. It does not include fixed fins, etc which form part of the structure.

nodes.title: Projectile built-in control mechanisms
nodes.definition: This element refers to the devices within the projectile which provide guidance control. For example navigation systems, laser target sensors, etc.

nodes.title: Surveillance, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to sense the environment.

nodes.title: Launcher surveillance, General
nodes.definition: The surveillance element is defined as all equipment (hardware/software) and associated systems used to sense the surrounding environment and then process, display and record the resulting information. This can include, for example, Meteorological equipment. It does not include specific thermal imaging or meteorological/atmospheric systems.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to the processing, control and recording elements of the sensor systems. It includes central processors, analogue/digital converters, associated software, storage units, etc.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used to indicate/monitor sensor information. It includes data identification, indicators, displays panels, etc.

nodes.title: Recording
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used to record sensor information.

nodes.title: Infra-red
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system that uses heat-sensing devices to acquire information. It includes infra-red scanners and image intensifiers. It does not include specific thermal imaging systems.

nodes.title: Laser
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system that uses laser devices to acquire information. It includes distance measuring, target identification, etc.

nodes.title: Radar
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system that uses radar devices to acquire information. It includes antennas, receivers, transmitters, indicators, etc.

nodes.title: Magnetic
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system that uses magnetic sensors to acquire information. It includes magnetometers, amplifiers, processors, indicators, etc.

nodes.title: Sonar
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system that uses sonar to acquire information. It includes modulators, transducers, processors, indicators, etc.

nodes.title: Acoustic
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system that uses sound to acquire information. It includes listening devices, amplifiers, processors, indicators, etc.

nodes.title: Launcher sensors, General
nodes.definition: The sensor element refers to those systems (hardware/software) within the launcher that provide data required for targeting, launch, arming and payload delivery.

nodes.title: Radar
nodes.definition: The radar element refers to those radar systems (hardware/software) within the launcher that provide data required for targeting, launch, arming and payload delivery.

nodes.title: Sonar
nodes.definition: The sonar element refers to those sonar systems (hardware/software) within the launcher that provide data required for targeting, launch, arming and payload delivery.

nodes.title: Thermal
nodes.definition: The thermal imaging element refers to those thermal imaging and image intensifying systems (hardware/ software) within the launcher that provide data required for targeting, launch, and payload delivery.

nodes.title: Laser
nodes.definition: The laser element refers to those laser target-designator systems (hardware/software) within the launcher that provide data required for targeting, launch, arming and payload delivery.

nodes.title: Magnetic
nodes.definition: The magnetic element refers to those magnetic systems (hardware/software) within the launcher that provide data required for targeting, launch, arming and payload delivery.

nodes.title: Acoustic
nodes.definition: The acoustic element refers to those sound sensing systems (hardware/ software) within the launcher that provide data required for targeting, launch, arming and payload delivery.

nodes.title: Pressure
nodes.definition: The pressure element refers to those pressure systems (hardware/software) within the launcher that provide data required for targeting, launch, arming and payload delivery.

nodes.title: Proximity
nodes.definition: This element refers to the proximity sensing systems (hardware/software) within the launcher that provide proximity sensing data required for targeting, launch, arming and payload delivery.

nodes.title: Projectile sensors, General
nodes.definition: The sensor element refers to those systems (hardware/software) within the projectile that provide data required for targeting, launch, arming and payload delivery.

nodes.title: Radar
nodes.definition: The radar element refers to those radar systems (hardware/software) within the projectile that provide data required for targeting, launch, arming and payload delivery.

nodes.title: Sonar

nodes.title: Laser

nodes.title: Magnetic

nodes.title: Acoustic

nodes.title: Pressure
nodes.definition: The pressure element refers to those pressure systems (hardware/software) within the projectile that provide data required for targeting, launch, arming and payload delivery.

nodes.title: Proximity
nodes.definition: This element refers to the proximity sensing systems (hardware/software) within the projectile that provide proximity sensing data required for targeting, launch, arming and payload delivery.

nodes.title: Meteorological/atmospheric research, General
nodes.definition: Refers to the systems and devices which furnish a means of providing, processing and recording meteorological data.

nodes.title: Weather
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system which is used to detect, measure, process or record weather (moisture, temperature, cloud, wind, etc) data. It includes hygrometers, thermometers, anemometers, etc.

nodes.title: Air turbulence
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system which is used to detect, measure, process or record air turbulence data.

nodes.title: Pollutants
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system which is used to detect, measure, process or record contaminated particles.

nodes.title: Magnetic/gravitational
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system which is used to detect, measure, process or record the earth's magnetic or gravitational forces.

nodes.title: Steering, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to guide or govern direction.

nodes.title: Launcher guidance, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the devices within the launcher used to guide or govern direction of the projectile.

nodes.title: Guidance mechanism
nodes.definition: This element refers to the devices (hardware/software) within the launcher used to govern direction of the projectile.

nodes.title: Projectile guidance, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the devices within the projectile used to govern direction or placement.

nodes.title: Projectile direction control
nodes.definition: This element refers to the devices within the projectile which provide direction control. For example rudders, etc.

nodes.title: Ventilation/heating/cooling, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to provide a controlled environment.

nodes.title: Launcher ventilation/heating/cooling, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to those subassemblies or components which provide a micro-climatic condition (heating or cooling), for the launcher, including heating/cooling suits or components. It also covers purification systems not covered by NBC.

nodes.title: Compression
nodes.definition: That portion of the system and its controls which supplies pressurized air/gas. Includes items such as controls and indicating systems related to pressure, gas-filled systems, etc.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: That portion of the system used to induct and distribute air. It includes equipment rack cooling, seals, demisting, waveguide pressurization system and items of such systems, like blowers, ducting and inlets.

nodes.title: Heating
nodes.definition: That portion of the system and its controls which supply heated air. It includes items such as heater units, wiring, etc.

nodes.title: Cooling
nodes.definition: That portion of the system and its controls which supply cooled air. Includes items such as the cooling unit, indicating systems related to the cooler operation, wiring etc. Does not include temperature control and indicating systems.

nodes.title: Temperature control
nodes.definition: That portion of the system used to control the temperature of the air. Includes items such as, thermal sensing devices, switches, indicators, wiring etc.

nodes.title: Moisture/air
nodes.definition: That portion of the system used to contaminant control moisture in the air, to control ozone concentrations, to filter radioactive debris and chemical/biological contaminants, etc.

nodes.title: Liquid coolant
nodes.definition: Those components required to supply liquid coolant to a cooling system.

nodes.title: Projectile ventilation/heating/cooling, General
nodes.definition: Those units and components which furnish a means of pressurizing, heating, cooling, moisture controlling, filtering and treating the air/gas used to condition areas of the projectile system environment. It includes cooling, heating, vents, ducts, seals, wiring etc.

nodes.title: Compression
nodes.definition: That portion of the system and its controls which supplies pressurized air/gas. Includes items such as controls and indicating systems related to pressure, gas-filled systems, etc.

nodes.title: Distribution

nodes.title: Cooling

nodes.title: Temperature control
nodes.definition: That portion of the system used to control the temperature of the air. Includes items such as, thermal sensing devices, switches, indicators, wiring etc.

nodes.title: Moisture/air
nodes.definition: That portion of the system used to contaminant control moisture in the air, to control ozone concentrations, to filter radioactive debris and chemical/biological contaminants, etc.

nodes.title: Liquid coolant
nodes.definition: Those components required to supply liquid coolant to an equipment cooling system.

nodes.title: Hydraulic systems, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment for generation, distribution and/or control of hydraulic (or pneumatic) power.

nodes.title: Launcher hydraulic system, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to a system or equipment within the launcher for the generation, distribution and/or control of hydraulic power.

nodes.title: Main
nodes.definition: This element refers to a system or equipment within the launcher which is used to generate, store, distribute or control hydraulic power. It includes such items as tanks, valves, pumps, plumbing, etc. It does not include user systems classified elsewhere, or their connecting valves.

nodes.title: Auxiliary
nodes.definition: That portion of the launcher hydraulic system which is classified as auxiliary, emergency or standby and which is used to supplement, or replace the main hydraulic system.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: That part of the launcher hydraulic system which is used to monitor condition of the hydraulic system or fluid. It includes transmitters, indicators, warning systems, etc.

nodes.title: Projectile hydraulic system, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to a system or equipment within the projectile for the generation, distribution and/or control of hydraulic power.

nodes.title: Main
nodes.definition: This element refers to a system or equipment within the projectile which is used to generate, store, distribute or control hydraulic power. It includes such items as tanks, valves, pumps, plumbing, etc. It does not include user systems classified elsewhere, or their connecting valves.

nodes.title: Auxiliary
nodes.definition: That portion of the projectile hydraulic system which is classified as auxiliary, emergency or standby and which is used to supplement, or replace the main hydraulic system.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: That part of the projectile hydraulic system which is used to monitor condition of the hydraulic system or fluid. It includes transmitters, indicators, warning systems, etc.

nodes.title: Launcher pneumatic systems, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to a system or equipment (hardware/software) within the launcher for the generation, distribution and/ or control of pneumatic (including vacuum) power.

nodes.title: Main
nodes.definition: This element refers to a system or equipment within the launcher which is used to generate, store, distribute or control pneumatic power. It includes such items as tanks, valves, pumps, plumbing, etc. It does not include user systems classified elsewhere, or their connecting valves.

nodes.title: Auxiliary
nodes.definition: That portion of the launcher pneumatic system which is classified as auxiliary, emergency or standby and which is used to supplement, or replace the main pneumatic system.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: That part of the launcher pneumatic system which is used to monitor condition of the system. It includes transmitters, indicators, warning systems, etc.

nodes.title: Projectile pneumatic systems, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to a system or equipment (hardware/software) within the projectile for the generation, distribution and/or control of pneumatic (including vacuum) power.

nodes.title: Main
nodes.definition: This element refers to a system or equipment within the projectile which is used to generate, store, distribute or control pneumatic power. It includes such items as tanks, valves, pumps, plumbing, etc. It does not include user systems classified elsewhere, or their connecting valves.

nodes.title: Auxiliary
nodes.definition: That portion of the projectile pneumatic system which is classified as auxiliary, emergency or standby and which is used to supplement, or replace the main pneumatic system.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: That part of the projectile pneumatic system which is used to monitor condition of the system. It includes transmitters, indicators, warning systems, etc.

nodes.title: Electronic system, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment using electronic/automated software and/or firmware elements not specifically included in other systems.

nodes.title: Launcher electronic system, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to a system or equipment within the launcher which uses electronic/automated software and/or firmware elements not specifically included in other systems.

nodes.title: Projectile electronic system, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to a system or equipment within the projectile which uses electronic/automated software and/or firmware elements not specifically included in other systems.

nodes.title: Auxiliary, General
nodes.definition: Subsidiary systems that provide services or support to main systems or equipment.

nodes.title: Launcher auxiliary systems, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to subsidiary systems that provide services or support to main systems or equipment related to the launcher system.

nodes.title: Magazine
nodes.definition: The magazine element refers to the structure or compartment for storing ammunition or explosives in a 'ready for use' condition, or position, not directly mounted on the launcher.

nodes.title: Projectile auxiliary systems, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to subsidiary systems that provide services or support to main systems or equipment within the projectile.

nodes.title: Adapter kits, General
nodes.definition: The adapter kits element refers to the equipment (hardware/software) for adapting the launch system to particular applications. For example, vehicle adapter kits and for adaption to different aircraft and/ or ship models. Also, kits for backpacking, etc.

nodes.title: Survivability, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to provide hazard detection, protection, survivability and escape facilities.

nodes.title: Launcher fire protection systems, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to systems (hardware/software) that provide a warning to the launcher crew that a possible fire hazard exists. It includes the suppression/fire fighting and heat sensors required for this system.

nodes.title: Detecting
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the system which is used to sense the presence of excessive heat, smoke or fire.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the system which is used to indicate the presence of excessive heat, smoke or fire.

nodes.title: Extinguishing
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the system, either fixed or portable, which is used to extinguish fire.

nodes.title: Launcher nuclear, biological and chemical protection, General
Launcher nuclear, biological and chemical protection, General
nodes.definition: The NBC element refers to those subassemblies or components which provide nuclear, biological and chemical detection, protection and survivability to the launcher and/ or crew, either individually or collectively, during an NBC attack. This can include a positive pressure system, purification system, ventilated face piece (mask), NBC detection and warning devices, decontamination equipment and chemical resistant coatings. It can also include environmental control equipment, such as heaters, coolers, etc.

nodes.title: Pack
nodes.definition: Refers to NBC protection packs.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to NBC protection controls.

nodes.title: Pressure relief
nodes.definition: Refers to pressure relief devices specifically fitted for NBC protection purposes.

nodes.title: Door assemblies
nodes.definition: Refers to NBC protection fitted to doors and hatches.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls and associated systems. It can include, for example, such items as wiring, connectors, heaters, coolers and ducting.

nodes.title: Projectile fire protection systems, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to systems (hardware/software) that provide a warning within the projectile that a possible fire hazard exists. It includes the suppression/fire fighting and heat sensors required for this system.

nodes.title: Detecting
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the system which is used to sense the presence of excessive heat, smoke or fire.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the system which is used to indicate the presence of excessive heat, smoke or fire.

nodes.title: Extinguishing
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the system, either fixed or portable, which is used to extinguish fire.

nodes.title: Projectile nuclear, biological and chemical protection, General
Projectile nuclear, biological and chemical protection, General
nodes.definition: The NBC element refers to those subassemblies or components which provide nuclear, biological and chemical detection, protection and survivability to the projectile, either individually or collectively, during an NBC attack. This includes a positive pressure system, purification system, NBC detection and protection devices, decontamination equipment and chemical resistant coatings.

nodes.title: Pack
nodes.definition: Refers to NBC protection packs.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to NBC protection controls.

nodes.title: Pressure relief
nodes.definition: Refers to pressure relief devices specifically fitted for NBC protection purposes.

nodes.title: Door assemblies
nodes.definition: Refers to NBC protection fitted to doors and hatches.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls and associated systems. It includes such items as wiring, connectors, etc.

nodes.title: Special equipment, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to provide a special mission capability.

nodes.title: Launcher special to type equipment, General
Launcher special to type equipment, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to that special equipment (hardware/software) to be mated to a launcher, to enable the achievement of a special mission capability, recovery operations, winterization, etc. It can include, for example blades, booms, cranes, winches, robotic arms, and manipulators.

nodes.title: Launcher special recovery equipment
nodes.definition: This element refers to that special recovery equipment (hardware/software) to be mated to a launcher, to enable the achievement of a recovery capability. It includes cranes and towing equipment.

nodes.title: Launcher special fit equipment
nodes.definition: This element refers to that special fit equipment (hardware/software) to be mated to a launcher, to enable the achievement of a specialized capability. It will include supply, DROPS, lift trucks, side loaders, etc.

nodes.title: Launcher special purpose equipment
nodes.definition: This element refers to that special-to-purpose equipment (hardware/software) to be mated to a launcher, for the achievement of a special mission purpose. It covers, for example, ISO container bodies and equipment and other special purpose vehicles.

nodes.title: Installation kit
nodes.definition: The installation kit element refers to the equipment (hardware/software) for installation of the launch system related to a particular application.

nodes.title: Portability kit
nodes.definition: The portability kit refers to that equipment required to prepare the launcher for transportation, other than its prime means of movement.

nodes.title: Bore variation/velocity change kits
nodes.definition: This refers to equipment (hardware/software) designed to affect the velocity of a projectile.

nodes.title: Winterization kit
nodes.definition: The winterization kit element refers to the equipment (hardware/software) for protection of the launcher/ crew, in adverse weather conditions.

nodes.title: Projectile special equipment/systems, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to provide a special mission capability for the projectile.

nodes.title: Portability kit
nodes.definition: The portability kit refers to that equipment required to prepare projectiles for transportation.

nodes.title: Outfit and furnishings, General
nodes.definition: A function or equipment used to provide habitability or operability that is not specifically included in other systems.

nodes.title: Launcher stowage, General
nodes.definition: This element is required to provide for personal equipment stowage as well as operational equipment stowage on or in the launcher.

nodes.title: Charge bin
nodes.definition: Refers to charge bin stowage facilities.

nodes.title: Shell stowage
nodes.definition: Refers to shell stowage facilities.

nodes.title: Ammunition
nodes.definition: Refers to stowage facilities for both secondary and personal ammunition.

nodes.title: Launcher internal
nodes.definition: Refers to stowage facilities within the launcher.

nodes.title: Launcher external
nodes.definition: Refers to stowage facilities mounted on launcher.

nodes.title: Complete equipment schedule (CES), General
nodes.definition: This element refers to lists detailing the equipment required by the user to operate and maintain the system. It includes, for example, both fitted and loose items, spares, tools and operator manuals.

nodes.title: Production CES
nodes.definition: This element refers to the production version of the CES.

nodes.title: Service CES
nodes.definition: This element refers to the service version of the CES.

nodes.title: Complex CES
nodes.definition: This element refers to the complex version of the CES.

nodes.title: Projectile stowage, General
nodes.definition: This element is required to provide for equipment stowage on or in the projectile.

nodes.title: Training, General
nodes.definition: The training element is defined as the deliverable training services, devices, accessories, aids, equipment and facilities used to provide instruction through which personnel will acquire sufficient concepts, skills and aptitudes to both operate and maintain the system with maximum efficiency. This element includes all effort associated design, development and production of deliverable training equipment as well as the execution of training services.

nodes.title: Training services, General
nodes.definition: The training services element refers to the deliverable training services, used to provide instruction through which personnel will acquire sufficient concepts, skills and aptitudes to both operate and maintain the system with maximum efficiency.

nodes.title: Devices/accessories/aids
nodes.definition: The training devices/accessories/aids element refers to the deliverable devices, accessories and aids used to provide instruction through which personnel will acquire sufficient concepts, skills and aptitudes to both operate and maintain the system with maximum efficiency.

nodes.title: Equipment
nodes.definition: The training equipment element refers to the deliverable training equipment used to provide instruction through which personnel will acquire sufficient concepts, skills and aptitudes to both operate and maintain the system with maximum efficiency.

nodes.title: Facilities
nodes.definition: The training facilities element refers to the deliverable training facilities used to provide instruction through which personnel will acquire sufficient concepts, skills and aptitudes to both operate and maintain the system with maximum efficiency.

nodes.title: Repair test and support, General
nodes.definition: A system, equipment or facilities used to maintain operational capability.

nodes.title: Launcher repair facilities, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the facility which will allow unserviceable launchers to be repaired, tested and returned to service use.

nodes.title: Mobile
nodes.definition: This element refers to a mobile facility which will allow unserviceable launchers to be repaired, tested and returned to service use.

nodes.title: Fixed
nodes.definition: This element refers to a static facility which will allow unserviceable launchers to be repaired, tested and returned to service use.

nodes.title: Sighting systems repair facility, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to equipment (hardware/software) that enables the repair, test or calibration of the optical sighting equipment, including laser range finders for example.

nodes.title: Mobile
nodes.definition: Refers to mobile (man-porTable or vehicle mounted) equipment (hardware/software), which can be in a vehicle container or box body, that enables the repair, test and/or calibration of optical sighting equipment.

nodes.title: Fixed
nodes.definition: Refers to static (permanent or temporary) equipment (hardware/software) that enables the repair, test or calibration of optical sighting equipment.

nodes.title: Thermal imaging repair facility, General
nodes.definition: To provide a transportable facility (hardware/software) whereby thermal imaging equipment including its associated cooling systems can be repaired, tested and returned to service. The equipment covered will include, for example, clean air equipment, jigs, fixtures, computer interface adapters and test equipment.

nodes.title: Mobile
nodes.definition: Refers to mobile (man-portable or vehicle mounted) equipment (hardware/software), which can be in a vehicle container or box body, that enables the repair, test and/or calibration of thermal imaging equipment.

nodes.title: Fixed
nodes.definition: Refers to static (permanent or temporary) equipment (hardware/software) that enables the repair, test or calibration of thermal imaging equipment.

nodes.title: General purpose electronic repair facility, General
General purpose electronic repair facility, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to equipment (hardware/software) that enables unserviceable electrical/electronic items to be repaired, tested and returned to service use.

nodes.title: Mobile
nodes.definition: Refers to mobile (man-portable or vehicle mounted) equipment (hardware/software), which can be in a vehicle container or box body, that enables the repair, test and/or calibration of general purpose electronic equipment.

nodes.title: Fixed
nodes.definition: Refers to static (permanent or temporary) equipment (hardware/software) that enables the repair, test or calibration of general purpose electronic equipment.

nodes.title: Projectile repair facilities, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the facility which will allow unserviceable projectiles to be repaired, tested and returned to service use.

nodes.title: Mobile
nodes.definition: This element refers to a mobile facility which will allow unserviceable projectiles to be repaired, tested and returned to service use.

nodes.title: Fixed
nodes.definition: This element refers to a static facility which will allow unserviceable projectiles to be repaired, tested and returned to service use.

nodes.title: Launcher common support equipment, General
nodes.definition: The launcher common support equipment element refers to those items required to support and maintain the launcher or portions of the launcher systems while not directly engaged in the performance of its mission, and which are presently in the MOD inventory for support of other systems. This element includes all efforts required to assure the availability of this equipment for support of the particular defense Product item. It also includes the acquisition of additional quantities of this equipment if caused by the introduction of the defense material item into operational service.

nodes.title: Projectile common support equipment, General
nodes.definition: The projectile common support equipment element refers to those items required to support and maintain the projectiles or portions of the projectile systems while not directly engaged in the performance of their mission, and which are presently in the MOD inventory for support of other systems. This element includes all efforts required to assure the availability of this equipment for support of the particular defense Product item. It also includes the acquisition of additional quantities of this equipment if caused by the introduction of the defense material item into operational service.

nodes.title: Launcher test and measurement equipment, General
Launcher test and measurement equipment, General
nodes.definition: The launcher test and measurement equipment element is defined as common testing and measurement equipment which allows an operator or maintenance function to evaluate operational conditions of a launcher system or equipment by performing specific diagnostics, screening or QA effort at an organizational, intermediate, or depot level of equipment support. It includes test measurement and diagnostic equipment, precision measuring equipment, automatic test equipment, manual test equipment, automatic test systems, test program sets, appropriate interconnect devices, automated load modules, tap(s), and related software, firmware and support hardware (power supply equipment, etc) used at all levels of maintenance. It includes packages which enable a line or shop replaceable unit, printed circuit boards, or similar items to be diagnosed using automatic test equipment.

nodes.title: Projectile test and measurement equipment, General
Projectile test and measurement equipment, General
nodes.definition: The projectile test and measurement equipment element is defined as common testing and measurement equipment which allows an operator or maintenance function to evaluate operational conditions of a projectile, subsystem or equipment by performing specific diagnostics, screening or QA effort at an organizational, intermediate, or depot level of equipment support. It includes test measurement and diagnostic equipment, precision measuring equipment, automatic test equipment, manual test equipment, automatic test systems, test program sets, appropriate interconnect devices, automated load modules, tap(s), and related software, firmware and support hardware (power supply equipment, etc) used at all levels of maintenance. It includes packages which enable a line or shop replaceable unit, printed circuit boards, or similar items to be diagnosed using automatic test equipment.

nodes.title: Launcher support and handling equipment, General
Launcher support and handling equipment, General
nodes.definition: The launcher support and handling equipment element is defined as the deliverable tools and handling equipment used for support of the launcher system. It typically includes ground support equipment, vehicular support equipment, powered support equipment, non-powered support equipment, and software support equipment.

nodes.title: Projectile support and handling equipment, General
Projectile support and handling equipment, General
nodes.definition: The projectile support and handling equipment element is defined as the deliverable tools and handling equipment used for support of the projectile (eg, munitions Product handling equipment and software support equipment).

nodes.title: Propulsion, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment for producing and delivering power.

nodes.title: Power pack, General
nodes.definition: The power pack element refers to a self-contained means for generating and delivering power. It includes such systems as the main engine, transmission and interfaces. Subsystems can include such items as cooling, fuel, air and exhaust, lubrication, auxiliaries and electrical.

nodes.title: Main engine
nodes.definition: Refers to a diesel, petrol, electric, etc, fuelled means for generating power and a means whereby this power can be delivered to the transmission It can include, for example, engine-mounted flywheel and clutch assemblies, cooling, fuel, air and exhaust, lubrication, auxiliary and electrical systems.

nodes.title: Transmission
nodes.definition: Refers to a system which transmits power from the engine to the driving member and can include torque converter and gearbox. It can also include flywheel and clutch assemblies, steering and brakes if they are integral to the transmission. Also included are differentials and power takeoffs.

nodes.title: Power pack interfaces
nodes.definition: Refers to the mounting assemblies connecting the main engine and transmission, together with associated ancillaries, including such systems as cooling, fuel, air and exhaust, lubrication, auxiliary and electrical. It can also include transmission items.

nodes.title: Power unit, General
nodes.definition: The power unit element refers to a discrete means for generating and delivering power to the transmission. It can include, for example, flywheel and clutch assemblies.

nodes.title: Engine
nodes.definition: Refers to a diesel, petrol, electric, etc, fuelled means for generating power and a means whereby this power can be delivered to the transmission. It can include, for example, flywheel and clutch assemblies and engine mounted cooling, fuel, air and exhaust, lubrication, auxiliary and electrical systems.

nodes.title: Cooling system
nodes.definition: Refers to systems designed to maintain the correct operating temperatures for the power unit. It includes, for example, cooling air ducting, coolant pumps, liquid filled radiators, intercoolers, fans and associated heat exchange equipment.

nodes.title: Fuel systems
nodes.definition: Refers to a system or equipment designed to deliver fuel to the power unit. It includes, for example, fuel storage facilities, pumps, filters, delivery pipes, drainage and cut-off valves, Fuel Injector Pumps (FIP) and injectors.

nodes.title: Air and exhaust systems
nodes.definition: Refers to a system which supplies air to, or collects and removes exhaust gasses from the engine. It includes, for example, all pipes, ducting, filters, couplings, gaskets, turbochargers/superchargers, silencers and catalytic converters.

nodes.title: Lubrication systems
nodes.definition: Refers to a system that provides lubrication to the power unit and any external components related to the power unit lubrication system. It includes, for example, delivery and return pipes, pumps, filters, intercoolers and separately mounted heat exchangers.

nodes.title: Electrical
nodes.definition: Refers to a system that provides or uses electrical power associated with the power unit. It includes, for example, starter motors, alternators and generators directly mounted on the power unit. It also includes, for example, ignition system components including spark plugs, distributor, coils and leads .

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls, items and associated systems in, or directly mounted on, the power unit. It includes, for example, engine mountings.

nodes.title: Hydraulic
nodes.definition: Refers to a system that provides or uses hydraulic power associated with the power unit. It includes, for example, hydraulic pumps, valves, pipes, and tanks. It also includes any external components related to the power unit hydraulic systems.

nodes.title: Engine cooling system, General
nodes.definition: This system includes cooling air ducting, coolant pumps, liquid filled radiators, fans and associated heat exchange equipment.

nodes.title: Fluid
nodes.definition: Refers to fluid (water/oil) filled coolant systems. It includes pumps, radiators, fans, pipes and associated heat exchange equipment.

nodes.title: Air
nodes.definition: Refers to cooling air ducting, fans and associated heat exchange equipment.

nodes.title: Fuel systems, General
nodes.definition: Equipment to provide fuel storage facilities, filters, delivery pipes, drainage and cut-off valves, Fuel Injector Pumps (FIP) and injectors mounted externally to the power unit/pack.

nodes.title: Storage
nodes.definition: Refers to the portion of the system which stores fuel. It includes, for example, tanks, filler necks, seals, valves, vents and drainage.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to the portion of the system which is used to distribute fuel from the storage system. It includes, for example, filters, restrictors, valves, controls and pipes.

nodes.title: Priming
nodes.definition: Refers to the portion of the system which is used to pressurize/pump the fuel. It includes, for example, lift pumps, pressurization pumps, and cold starting systems.

nodes.title: Fuel injection
nodes.definition: Refers to the portion of the system which delivers fuel. It includes, for example, FIP, fuel injectors, fuel pump metering and carburetors.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: Refers to the portion of the system which is used to monitor the condition of fuel (quantity, temperature and pressure). It includes, for example, transmitters, indicators, wiring and pressure warning systems.

nodes.title: Venting and de-fuelling
nodes.definition: Refers to the portion of the system which is used to vent fumes from the fuel system and to provide a means for removing/dumping unwanted fuel.

nodes.title: Air and exhaust systems, General
nodes.definition: Refers to a system which supplies and filters air to the engine and collects and removes exhaust gases from the engine. It includes, for example, all filters, pipes, couplings, silencers, catalytic converters and ducting mounted externally to the power unit/pack.

nodes.title: Air system
nodes.definition: Refers to a system which supplies and filters air to the engine. It includes, for example, pre-filters, main air filters, and associated ducting. It can also include air cooling/heating systems and intercoolers.

nodes.title: Collector
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system which collects exhaust gases from the engine manifold. It includes pipes, joints, gaskets, etc.

nodes.title: Noise suppression
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system which reduces noise produced by the engine exhaust gases. It includes silencers, baffles, shields, etc.

nodes.title: Emission control
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system which is designed to reduce or eliminate engine exhaust gas emissions. It includes, for example, catalytic converters and tail pipes.

nodes.title: Lubrication systems, General
nodes.definition: This system is to include lubrication storage facilities that are external to the engine/power pack. It includes delivery and return pipes, pumps, filters and heat exchangers mounted externally to the power unit/pack.

nodes.title: Storage
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used for storage of engine and/or transmission lubricating oil. It includes tanks, filling systems, sumps, drains, etc.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used for distribution of lubricating oil to and from the engine and/or transmission. It includes pipes, pumps, filters, valves, etc.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used to monitor the condition of engine and/or transmission lubricating oil (quantity, temperature and pressure). It includes transmitters, indicators, wiring, pressure warning systems, etc.

nodes.title: Transmission, General
nodes.definition: Refers to a means to transmit power from the engine to the driving member and can include clutch, torque converter, gearbox. It can also include steering and brakes if they are integral to the transmission. Also included are differentials and power takeoffs.

nodes.title: Gearbox
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for varying the speed/torque delivered from the power unit to the driving member. It can include the steering control and brake assemblies.

nodes.title: Steering control assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to a discrete means for varying the drive applied, through the transmission system, to each of the vehicle's driving members (eg, tracked vehicles).

nodes.title: Brake assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to a discrete means for applying braking forces through the vehicle transmission (eg, tracked vehicles).

nodes.title: Auxiliary drive/power takeoff
nodes.definition: Refers to an auxiliary means of obtaining an output from the engine. It includes transfer gearboxes which can also include a slip differential.

nodes.title: Clutch
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for engaging/disengaging the transmission to/from the engine, when fitted as a separate assembly (for clutches fitted to a flywheel, see A21000).

nodes.title: Drive shaft
nodes.definition: Refers to the means for connecting power output from the engine to the driving member. It includes muff couplings, propeller shafts, universal joints and final drives.

nodes.title: Torque converter
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for varying the torque delivered from the engine to the driving member.

nodes.title: Differential
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for changing the direction of rotation delivered from the engine to the driving member or wheels. For wheeled vehicles, it includes the driving axles, half shafts, hubs, etc.

nodes.title: Automotive/remote piloting and digital control systems, General
nodes.indexTitle: Automotive/remote piloting & digital control systems, General

nodes.title: Automotive/remote piloting and digital control systems, General
nodes.definition: The automotive and remote piloting and Digital Automotive Control System (DACS) element refers to that equipment (hardware/software) installed in the vehicle which is used to plan and control vehicle speed and direction either autonomously or via tele-operation. This includes equipment which senses, processes and displays imagery data such as stereo vision systems, laser scanners, multiple sensor fusion algorithms and processors, image enhancement algorithms and processors etc. This includes, for example, equipment which performs intelligence analysis and planning functions such as automated route planners, image understanding algorithms and processors, computer aided driving algorithms, DACS and processors.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to processing and control elements. It includes central processors, analogue/digital converters, associated software, memory boards, servo units, actuators, associated wiring, etc.

nodes.title: Sensors
nodes.definition: Refers to sensors which are specifically associated with providing inputs to an automotive/remote piloting system or DACS.

nodes.title: Indicators
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used to indicate/monitor an automotive/remote piloting system or DACS. It includes indicators, wiring, etc.

nodes.title: Controls (drivers), General
nodes.definition: Given in this element are the controls required to start, stop, steer and generally control the vehicle commensurate with the mobility role of the equipment. It includes, for example, on-board diagnostic systems.

nodes.title: Foot controls
nodes.definition: Refers to the foot-operated controls to start, stop, steer and generally control the vehicle. It includes, for example, pedal assemblies (clutch, brake, accelerator, etc), associated linkages, cables, hydraulic/pneumatic connections, master and slave cylinders, brake shoes and pads and disks and drums.

nodes.title: Hand controls
nodes.definition: Refers to the hand-operated controls to start, stop, steer and generally control the vehicle. It includes, for example, stop/start, steering (wheel, tiller, etc) and braking controls.

nodes.title: Ancillary controls
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls and associated systems. It includes, for example, such items as screen wash equipment, windscreen wipers and adjustable wing mirrors.

nodes.title: Propulsion control systems
nodes.definition: Refers to systems which monitor and/or control engine speed and performance.

nodes.title: Instrumentation
nodes.definition: Refers to systems (hardware/software) which monitor/report on the operation of vehicle systems. It includes, for example, the drivers instrumentation panel, warning lights and condition monitoring systems.

nodes.title: Structure, General
nodes.definition: Framework and/or basic structural housing for a system, including load bearing components.

nodes.title: Hull/frame, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the vehicles primary load bearing component which provides the structural integrity to withstand the operational loading stresses generated while traversing various terrain profiles. This element could be a simple wheeled vehicle frame or a more complicated combat vehicle hull which satisfies not only the structural requirements but also provides armor protection. It includes all structural subassemblies and appendages which attach directly to the primary structure. This element, for example, includes towing and lifting fittings, bumpers, hatches and grilles. It also includes provision to accommodate other Subsystems such as mountings for suspension, weapons, turret, track body, cab, special equipment, loads etc.

nodes.title: Internal mountings
nodes.definition: Refers to internal fitments mounted on the hull/frame. It includes brackets, stud welding, floors and insulation panels.

nodes.title: External mountings
nodes.definition: Refers to the chassis and external fitments mounted on the hull/frame. It includes brackets, stud welding, steps, bumpers, mud-guards, windows, etc.

nodes.title: Doors/hatches
nodes.definition: Refers to loading/entry hatches and doors in, or directly mounted on, the hull/frame assembly. It includes shell loading doors, driver and passenger doors, hatches, locks, handles, drivers/operators hoods, cowls and windshields, etc.

nodes.title: Seats
nodes.definition: Refers to seating which is directly mounted on the hull/frame.

nodes.title: Drinking water tank
nodes.definition: Refers to a system designed to provide drinking water for the driver and crew, which is directly mounted on the hull/frame. It includes tanks, filler necks, filters, pipes, seals, valves, vents, drainage, etc.

nodes.title: Access cover plates
nodes.definition: Refers to access cover plates directly mounted on the hull/frame. It includes, for example, guards, plugs, drain/inspection covers. It can also include deck area assemblies.

nodes.title: Gun crutch/depression rails
nodes.definition: Refers to gun crutch and depression rails directly mounted on the hull/frame.

nodes.title: Skirting plates/brackets/splash plates
nodes.definition: Refers to skirting plates, brackets and splash plates directly mounted on the hull/frame. It includes the plates and associated fittings, brackets, towing attachments, etc.

nodes.title: Body/cab, General
nodes.definition: Refers to the major components to be mated to a chassis or frame to provide a complete vehicle having a defined mission capability. This element includes accommodation for personnel, cargo, and such subsystems as need to be placed in proximity of the operators.

nodes.title: Internal mountings
nodes.definition: Refers to internal fitments mounted on the body/cab. It includes panels, brackets, clips, fascia, instrument panels, stud welding, internal windows, etc.

nodes.title: External mountings
nodes.definition: Refers to external fitments mounted on the body/cab. It includes the external cab assembly, panels, brackets, stud welding, steps, windows, cab tilt and locking mechanism, etc.

nodes.title: Doors/hatches
nodes.definition: Refers to loading/entry hatches and doors in, or directly mounted on, the body/cab. It includes loading doors, driver and passenger doors, hatches, locks, handles, etc.

nodes.title: Seats
nodes.definition: Refers to seating and associated fittings which are directly mounted on the body/cab. It includes, for example, seat belts and harnesses.

nodes.title: Drinking water tank
nodes.definition: Refers to a system designed to provide drinking water for the driver and crew, which is directly mounted on the body/cab. It includes tanks, filler necks, filters, pipes, seals, valves, vents, drainage, etc.

nodes.title: Access panels
nodes.definition: Refers to access panels directly mounted on the body/cab.

nodes.title: Load bay
nodes.definition: Refers to load (or passenger) carrying areas in the body/cab and any soft/hard top covering, supports, etc.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls, items and associated systems in, or directly mounted on, the body or cab.

nodes.title: Suspension/track/wheels, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the means for generating tractive effort, thrust and lift, generally at or in proximity to the earth's surface and adapting the vehicle to the irregularities of the surface. It includes, for example, wheels, tracks and steering gears for traction and control functions. Also, it includes springs, shock absorbers, skirts and other suspension members such as track adjusting mechanisms. It does not include specific steering mechanisms.

nodes.title: Suspension unit
nodes.definition: Refers to the means for adapting the vehicle to irregularities of the surface. It includes hydrogas units, shock absorbers, leaf and coil springs, pneumatic suspension units, etc. Also included is the lift mechanism, skirts, etc, for hovercraft.

nodes.title: Road wheel/hub assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for distributing the nominal ground pressure of the vehicle. On wheeled vehicles, it includes wheels that transfer tractive effort to the surface and rolling wheels. It includes road wheels, hub assemblies, tires, valves, inner-tubes, etc.

nodes.title: Sprocket wheel assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to the sprocket drive wheels which transfer tractive effort to the track.

nodes.title: Track assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to the track and associated linkages.

nodes.title: Idler wheels
nodes.definition: Refers to the feed/guide mechanism(s) associated with track laying. It includes idler wheels and track tensioners.

nodes.title: Roller assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to the track roller guide assemblies.

nodes.title: Axle
nodes.definition: Refers to non-driving axles not covered under the transmission system. It includes axle arms, links, bearings, etc.

nodes.title: Turret assembly, General
nodes.definition: The turret assembly refers to the structures and equipment installation required to provide the fighting compartment element of combat vehicles. This element includes turret armour, EMC shielding, turret rings, slip rings, attachments and appendages such as latches and cupolas, and accommodation for personnel, weapons and C 3 I.

nodes.title: Internal mountings
nodes.definition: Refers to internal fitments mounted in the turret. It includes drinking water installations, periscope mountings, panels, brackets, clips, stud welding, etc.

nodes.title: External mountings
nodes.definition: Refers to external fitments mounted on the turret. It includes brush deflector assemblies, cooler boxes, gun covers, splash curtains, panels, brackets, stud welding, etc.

nodes.title: Hatches
nodes.definition: Refers to loading/entry hatches in, or directly mounted on, the turret. It includes loading hatches, crew hatches and associated locks, handles, fittings, etc. It does not include cupolas.

nodes.title: Seats
nodes.definition: Refers to seating which is directly mounted in the turret.

nodes.title: Ring assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to a circular track and roller/ball-race assembly designed to facilitate turret rotation.

nodes.title: Cupola
nodes.definition: Refers to a roof aperture and domed hatch assembly, primarily for observation purposes. It can be capable of rotation, and can also provide access for entry/exit.

nodes.title: Elevating/traversing gearbox
nodes.definition: Refers to elevating traversing gearboxes mounted on the turret wall.

nodes.title: Turntable assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to the turret turntable assembly. It includes drive and roller assemblies, RBJ mountings, etc.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls, items and associated systems in, or directly mounted on, the turret. It includes such items as wash/wipe equipment, turret and elevation locks, position indicators and adjustable mirrors, etc.

nodes.title: Structures and buildings, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the structural portion of the electronic/automated software system. It includes, for example, frames, chassis, racks, etc.

nodes.title: Frame/chassis
nodes.definition: Refers to the structural frame or chassis of the electronic/automated software system.

nodes.title: Rack
nodes.definition: Refers to the mounting rack of the electronic/automated software system.

nodes.title: Fixtures/fittings
nodes.definition: Refers to fixtures and fittings in the racks of the electronic/automated software system. It includes, for example, blank panels, runners, bonding rails, anti-vibration mounts, grilles, cable trays and guides.

nodes.title: Encapsulation
nodes.definition: Refers to the enclosure of items within the electronic/automated software system by use of a potting compound.

nodes.title: Sites, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the physical make-up of a site where an electronic/automated software system is installed or housed. It includes, for example, boundaries, buildings, chambers, radomes and hard-standing.

nodes.title: Buildings
nodes.definition: Refers to the buildings in which the electronic/automated software system is housed.

nodes.title: Radomes
nodes.definition: Refers to the radomes in which the electronic/automated software system is housed.

nodes.title: Chambers
nodes.definition: Refers to the chambers in the electronic/automated software system. It includes, for example, underground chambers, cable and EMP vaults, secure and other storage areas.

nodes.title: Hard standing
nodes.definition: Refers to hard standing on the site where the electronic/automated software system is installed or located.

nodes.title: Masts, General
nodes.definition: Refers to structures erected to provide support for antennas etc. It includes, for example, masts, towers and securing equipment.

nodes.title: Masts
nodes.definition: Refers to those erected structures which are not free-standing.

nodes.title: Towers
nodes.definition: Refers to those erected structures which are free-standing.

nodes.title: Securing equipment
nodes.definition: Refers to the equipment and devices which is used to secure masts, towers and antennas.

nodes.title: Containers, General
nodes.definition: Refers to containers that form part of the electronic/automated software system. It includes, for example, ISO containers, cabins and cases.

nodes.title: ISO containers
nodes.definition: Refers to ISO containers which form part of the electronic/automated software system.

nodes.title: Cabins
nodes.definition: Refers to cabins which form part of the electronic/automated software system.

nodes.title: Cases
nodes.definition: Refers to covers and cases which form part of the electronic/automated software system.

nodes.title: Armaments, General
nodes.definition: A defensive or offensive system or equipment (including small arms and machine guns).

nodes.title: Electrical systems, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment for generation, distribution and/or control of electric power.

nodes.title: Mobile electrical systems (engine/power pack), General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the electrical or electronic systems for the engine/power pack. It will include wiring harnesses, line replaceable units (LRUs), sensors, lighting, batteries, generators, etc.

nodes.title: Generating
nodes.definition: Refers to generating systems and equipment in the engine/power pack compartment that are not directly mounted on the engine/power-pack. It includes such items as alternators, dynamos, generator panels, etc.

nodes.title: Batteries
nodes.definition: Refers to battery equipment mounted in the engine/power pack compartment. It includes such items as battery containers, lagging kits, battery assemblies, connecting straps, etc.

nodes.title: Instrumentation
nodes.definition: Refers to instrumentation systems and equipment mounted in the engine/power pack compartment. It includes such items as tachometers, speedometers, indicating panels, electronic circuit panels, control transmitters, etc.

nodes.title: Lights
nodes.definition: Refers to lighting systems and equipment mounted in the engine/power pack compartment. It includes such items as inspection lights, etc.

nodes.title: Wiring
nodes.definition: Refers to wiring and cable looms mounted in the engine/power pack compartment. It includes looms, wires, harnesses, etc.

nodes.title: Electrical equipment
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical equipment mounted in the engine/power pack compartment. It includes, for example, actuators, engine controls and ignition systems.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical distribution systems and equipment mounted in the engine/power pack compartment. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: Protection
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical protection systems and equipment mounted in the engine/power pack compartment. It includes such items as fuses, fusible links, trip switches, etc.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to control systems and equipment mounted in the engine/power pack compartment. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: Mobile electrical systems (hull/frame), General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the electrical or electronic systems for the hull and frame. It will include both internal and external wiring harnesses, junction and distribution boxes, line replaceable units (LRUs), sensors and lighting systems. It also includes the interfaces and connectors associated with the engine, power pack, generating and starting systems.

nodes.title: Internal electrical systems
nodes.definition: Refers to the internal electrical or electronic systems mounted in the hull/frame. It will include, for example, wiring harnesses, LRUs, junction and distribution boxes. It also includes the interfaces and connectors associated with the engine, power pack, generating and starting systems.

nodes.title: Batteries
nodes.definition: Refers to battery equipment related to the hull/frame. It includes such items as battery containers, lagging kits, battery assemblies, connecting straps, etc.

nodes.title: Internal lights
nodes.definition: Refers to lighting systems mounted internally in the hull/frame.

nodes.title: External electrical systems
nodes.definition: Refers to the electrical or electronic systems mounted externally on the hull/frame. It will include, for example, external lighting systems, horns and flashing beacons.

nodes.title: Wiring
nodes.definition: Refers to wiring, cable looms and clips related to the hull/frame or associated with connecting to the engine/power pack. It includes looms, wires, clips, harnesses, connectors, etc.

nodes.title: Electrical equipment
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical equipment related to the hull/frame. It includes, for example, actuators, wiper controls, heaters, cooking pots, horns, radio fittings and ancillary items.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical distribution and interconnecting systems and equipment related to the hull/frame. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: Protection
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical protection systems and equipment related to the hull/frame. It includes such items as fuses, fuse panels, fusible links, trip switches, etc.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to control systems and equipment related to the hull/frame. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: Mobile electrical systems (body/cab), General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the electrical or electronic systems for either the body or cab. It will include wiring harnesses, line replaceable units (LRUs), sensors and lighting systems.

nodes.title: Generating
nodes.definition: Refers to generating systems and equipment related to the body/cab. It includes such items as generator control panels, etc.

nodes.title: Batteries
nodes.definition: Refers to battery equipment related to the body/cab. It includes such items as battery containers, lagging kits, battery assemblies, connecting straps, etc.

nodes.title: Instrumentation
nodes.definition: Refers to instrumentation systems and equipment related to the body/cab. It includes such items as indicating panels, electronic circuit panels, control transmitters, etc.

nodes.title: Lights
nodes.definition: Refers to lighting systems and equipment related to the body/cab. It includes such items as inspection lights, head lights, spot lights, tail/side lights, indicators, panel lights, convoy lights, etc.

nodes.title: Wiring
nodes.definition: Refers to wiring and cable looms related to the body/cab. It includes looms, wires, harnesses, earthing straps, etc.

nodes.title: Electrical equipment
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical equipment related to the body cab. It includes, for example, actuators, wiper controls, heaters, cooking pots and horns.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical distribution systems and equipment related to the body/cab. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: Protection
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical protection systems and equipment related to the body/cab. It includes such items as fuses, fuse panels, fusible links, trip switches, etc.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to control systems and equipment related to the body/cab. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: Mobile electrical systems (turret), General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the electrical or electronic systems for the turret. It will include wiring harnesses, line replaceable units (LRUs), sensors and lighting systems.

nodes.title: Generating
nodes.definition: Refers to generating systems and equipment related to the turret. It includes such items as generator control panels, etc.

nodes.title: Batteries
nodes.definition: Refers to battery equipment related to the turret. It includes such items as battery containers, lagging kits, battery assemblies, connecting straps, etc.

nodes.title: Instrumentation
nodes.definition: Refers to instrumentation systems and equipment related to the turret. It includes such items as indicating panels, electronic circuit panels, control transmitters, etc.

nodes.title: Lights
nodes.definition: Refers to lighting systems and equipment related to the turret. It includes such items as inspection lights, panel lights, roof lights, spot lights, convoy lights, etc.

nodes.title: Wiring
nodes.definition: Refers to wiring and cable looms related to the turret. It includes looms, wires, harnesses, earthing straps, etc.

nodes.title: Electrical equipment
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical equipment related to the turret. It includes, for example, actuators, wiper controls, heaters and cooking pots.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical distribution systems and equipment related to the turret. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: Protection
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical protection systems and equipment related to the turret. It includes such items as fuses, fuse panels, fusible links, trip switches, etc.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to control systems and equipment related to the turret. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: Power supply, General
nodes.definition: Refers to the systems, subsystems, equipment and devices which provide power for a non-mobile facility. It includes, for example, AC power, DC power, external power and protection.

nodes.title: Communications, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment for transferring information.

nodes.title: Communications systems, General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the devices within the electronic/automated software system which provide the means for transmitting and receiving data. It includes, for example, fixed, tactical and mobile systems.

nodes.title: UHF/SHF/EHF
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that is used for communications utilizing UHF/SHF/EHF carriers (excluding satellite). It includes, for example, transmitters, receivers, antennas, signal processors, modems, etc.

nodes.title: VHF
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that is used for communications utilizing VHF carriers. It includes, for example, transmitters, receivers, antennas, signal processors, modems, etc.

nodes.title: HF
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that is used for communications utilizing HF carriers. It includes, for example, transmitters, receivers, antennas, signal processors, modems, etc.

nodes.title: LF
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that is used for communications utilizing LF carriers. It includes transmitters, receivers, antennas, signal processors, modems, etc.

nodes.title: Digital
nodes.definition: That portion of the electronic/automated software system that is used for digital/data communications. It includes, for example, data processors and DC line bays.

nodes.title: Audio/video
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that is used for audio and visual communications. It includes, for example, telephone equipment, fax machines, public address systems, modems and audio line bays.

nodes.title: Satellite
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that is used for communications via satellite. It includes, for example, satellite ground stations, fixed, transportable and portable satellite ground terminals.

nodes.title: Command & control
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that is used for command and control. It includes, for example, network and system control centers and other command and control subsystems.

nodes.title: Signal distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that distributes signals. It includes, for example, switching matrices, combiners, dividers, slip-rings and commutators.

nodes.title: Connectivity, General
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that provides connectivity. It includes, for example, landlines, twin-feeders, waveguides, inter and intra connection cabling, fiber optic cables and patching facilities.

nodes.title: Landlines
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that provides connectivity via landline.

nodes.title: Twin feeders
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that provides connectivity via twin feeders.

nodes.title: Inter-connectivity
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that provides inter-connectivity

nodes.title: Intra-connectivity
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that provides intra-connectivity

nodes.title: Optical fibre
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that provides connectivity via optical fiber cables.

nodes.title: Patching facilities
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that provides patching/switching facilities within the connectivity area. It includes, for example, jack-field panels.

nodes.title: Power cables
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that provides power connectivity.

nodes.title: Antennas, General
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that radiates or absorbs electromagnetic waves.

nodes.title: UHF/SHF/EHF
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that radiates or absorbs electromagnetic waves in the UHF/SHF/EHF frequency bands.

nodes.title: VHF
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that radiates or absorbs electromagnetic waves in the VHF frequency band.

nodes.title: HF
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that radiates or absorbs electromagnetic waves in the HF frequency band.

nodes.title: Tempest, General
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system that provides TEMPEST protection. It includes, for example, cages and vaults.

nodes.title: Cages
nodes.definition: Refers to the cages in the electronic/automated software systems that provide TEMPEST protection.

nodes.title: Vaults
nodes.definition: Refers to the vaults in the electronic/automated software systems that provide TEMPEST protection.

nodes.title: Navigation, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to determine, conduct, manage, or plot a position or course.

nodes.title: Navigation systems, General
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system that provides range, bearing and/or height information for the system.

nodes.title: Radar
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system which uses radar principles to provide range, bearing and/or height information. It includes, for example, air defense, precision and tracking radars.

nodes.title: Radio guidance
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system which uses modulated radio waves to provide range, bearing and/or height information. It includes, for example, beacons, landing aids and direction finding equipment.

nodes.title: Laser
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system which uses laser principles to provide range, bearing and/or height information.

nodes.title: Satellite
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system which uses satellites to provide range, bearing and/or height information. It includes, for example, both satellite and ground positioning elements.

nodes.title: Magnetic
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system which uses magnetic principles to provide range and/or bearing information. It includes, for example, compasses.

nodes.title: Thermal
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system which uses heat sensing or infra-red principles to provide range, bearing and/or height information.

nodes.title: Optical
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system which uses optical sighting to provide range, bearing and/or height information.

nodes.title: Surveillance, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to sense the environment.

nodes.title: Surveillance systems, General
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system which senses, monitors and, where required provides alarms and environmental data. It includes, for example, radar, sonar, thermal, optical and environmental technologies.

nodes.title: Radar
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system which uses the principles of radar.

nodes.title: Sonar
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system which uses the principles of sonar.

nodes.title: Thermal
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system which uses thermal imaging/intensifying and temperature monitoring principles. It includes, for example, electronic thermostats and IR detectors.

nodes.title: Optical
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system which uses optical and/or laser principles. It includes, for example, CCTV.

nodes.title: Magnetic
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system which uses magnetic principles.

nodes.title: Acoustic
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system which uses acoustic principles.

nodes.title: Pressure
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system which operates through pressure sensing techniques.

nodes.title: Proximity
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system which operates through proximity sensing techniques.

nodes.title: Environmental
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the electronic/automated software system which provides environmental data. It includes, for example, air quality (NBC, smoke) and weather (anemometer) monitoring.

nodes.title: Steering, General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to guide or govern direction.

nodes.title: Steering systems, General
nodes.definition: Refers to those units and devices within the electronic/automated software system which govern movement and/or direction of assemblies. It includes, for example, motors, gearboxes, drives and turning gear.

nodes.title: Motors
nodes.definition: Refers to the motor drive units within the electronic/automated software system which affect movement and/or direction of assemblies.

nodes.title: Gearboxes
nodes.definition: Refers to the geared units within the electronic/automated software system which vary torque, speed and/or direction of movement of assemblies.

nodes.title: Drives
nodes.definition: Refers to the interconnecting links between motor, gearbox and device, within the electronic/automated software system, which affect movement and/or direction of assemblies.

nodes.title: Turning gear
nodes.definition: Refers to the final drive link to moving assemblies within the electronic/automated software system.

nodes.title: Control systems
nodes.definition: Refers to those units within the electronic/automated software system which control movement and/or direction of assemblies.

nodes.title: Ventilation cooling & heating
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to provide a controlled environment.

nodes.title: Ventilation cooling & heating systems, General
