It includes, for example, starter motors, alternators and generators directly mounted on the power unit. It also includes, for example, ignition system components including spark plugs, distributor, coils and leads.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls, items and associated systems in, or directly mounted on, the power unit. It includes, for example, engine mountings.

nodes.title: Hydraulic
nodes.definition: Refers to a system that provides or uses hydraulic power associated with the power unit. It includes, for example, hydraulic pumps, valves, pipes, and tanks. It also includes any external components related to the power unit hydraulic systems.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This system includes cooling air ducting, coolant pumps, liquid filled radiators, fans and associated heat exchange equipment mounted externally to the power unit/pack.

nodes.title: Fluid
nodes.definition: Refers to fluid (water/oil) filled coolant systems. It includes pumps, radiators, fans, pipes and associated heat exchange equipment.

nodes.title: Air
nodes.definition: Refers to cooling air ducting, fans and associated heat exchange equipment.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Equipment to provide fuel storage facilities, filters, delivery pipes, drainage and cut-off valves, Fuel Injector Pumps (FIP) and injectors mounted externally to the power unit/pack.

nodes.title: Storage
nodes.definition: Refers to the portion of the system which stores fuel. It includes, for example, tanks, filler necks, seals, valves, vents and drainage.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to the portion of the system which is used to distribute fuel from the storage system. It includes, for example, filters, restrictors, valves, controls and pipes.

nodes.title: Priming
nodes.definition: Refers to the portion of the system which is used to pressurize/pump the fuel. It includes, for example, lift pumps, pressurization pumps, and cold starting systems.

nodes.title: Fuel injection
nodes.definition: Refers to the portion of the system which delivers fuel. It includes, for example, FIP, fuel injectors, fuel pump metering and carburetors.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: Refers to the portion of the system which is used to monitor the condition of fuel (quantity, temperature and pressure). It includes, for example, transmitters, indicators, wiring and pressure warning systems.

nodes.title: Venting and de-fuelling
nodes.definition: Refers to the portion of the system which is used to vent fumes from the fuel system and to provide a means for removing/dumping unwanted fuel.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to a system which supplies and filters air to the engine and collects and removes exhaust gases from the engine. It includes, for example, all filters, pipes, couplings, silencers, catalytic converters and ducting mounted externally to the power unit/pack.

nodes.title: Air system
nodes.definition: Refers to a system which supplies and filters air to the engine. It includes, for example, pre-filters, main air filters, and associated ducting. It can also include air cooling/heating systems and intercoolers.

nodes.title: Collector
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system which collects exhaust gases from the engine manifold. It includes pipes, joints, gaskets, etc.

nodes.title: Noise suppression
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system which reduces noise produced by the engine exhaust gases. It includes silencers, baffles, shields, etc.

nodes.title: Emission control
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system which is designed to reduce or eliminate engine exhaust gas emissions. It includes, for example, catalytic converters and tail pipes.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This system includes lubrication storage facilities that are external to the engine/power pack. It includes delivery and return pipes, pumps, filters and heat exchangers mounted externally to the power unit/pack.

nodes.title: Storage
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used for storage of engine and/or transmission lubricating oil. It includes tanks, filling systems, sumps, drains, etc.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used for distribution of lubricating oil to and from the engine and/or transmission. It includes pipes, pumps, filters, valves, etc.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used to monitor the condition of engine and/or transmission lubricating oil (quantity, temperature and pressure). It includes transmitters, indicators, wiring, pressure warning systems, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to a means to transmit power from the engine to the driving member and can include clutch, torque converter, and gearbox. It can also include steering and brakes if they are integral to the transmission. Also included are differentials and power takeoffs.

nodes.title: Gearbox
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for varying the speed/torque delivered from the power unit to the driving member. It can include the steering control and brake assemblies.

nodes.title: Steering control assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to a discrete means for varying the drive applied, through the transmission system, to each of the vehicle's driving members (eg, tracked vehicles).

nodes.title: Brake assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to a discrete means for applying braking forces through the vehicle transmission (eg, tracked vehicles).

nodes.title: Auxiliary drive/power takeoff
nodes.definition: Refers to an auxiliary means of obtaining an output from the engine. It includes transfer gearboxes which can also include a slip differential.

nodes.title: Clutch
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for engaging/disengaging the transmission to/from the engine, when fitted as a separate assembly (for clutches fitted to a flywheel, see A21000).

nodes.title: Drive shaft
nodes.definition: Refers to the means for connecting power output from the engine to the driving member. It includes muff couplings, propeller shafts, universal joints and final drives.

nodes.title: Torque converter
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for varying the torque delivered from the engine to the driving member.

nodes.title: Differential
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for changing the direction of rotation delivered from the engine to the driving member or wheels. For wheeled vehicles, it includes the driving axles, half shafts, hubs, etc.

nodes.title: Automotive/remote piloting and digital control systems, General
General
nodes.definition: The automotive and remote piloting and Digital Automotive Control System (DACS) element refers to that equipment (hardware/software) installed in the vehicle which is used to plan and control vehicle speed and direction either autonomously or via tele-operation. This includes equipment which senses, processes and displays imagery data such as stereo vision systems, laser scanners, multiple sensor fusion algorithms and processors, image enhancement algorithms and processors etc. This includes, for example, equipment which performs intelligence analysis and planning functions such as automated route planners, image understanding algorithms and processors, computer aided driving algorithms, DACS and processors.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to processing and control elements. It includes central processors, analogue/digital converters, associated software, memory boards, servo units, actuators, associated wiring, etc.

nodes.title: Sensors
nodes.definition: Refers to sensors which are specifically associated with providing inputs to an automotive/remote piloting system or DACS.

nodes.title: Indicators
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used to indicate/monitor an automotive/remote piloting system or DACS. It includes indicators, wiring, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Given in this element are the controls required to start, stop, steer and generally control the vehicle commensurate with the mobility role of the equipment. It includes, for example, on-board diagnostic systems.

nodes.title: Foot controls
nodes.definition: Refers to the foot-operated controls to start, stop, steer and generally control the vehicle. It includes, for example, pedal assemblies (clutch, brake, accelerator, etc), associated linkages, cables, hydraulic/pneumatic connections, master and slave cylinders, brake shoes and pads and disks and drums.

nodes.title: Hand controls
nodes.definition: Refers to the hand-operated controls to start, stop, steer and generally control the vehicle. It includes, for example, stop/start, steering (wheel, tiller, etc) and braking controls.

nodes.title: Ancillary controls
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls and associated systems. It includes, for example, such items as screen wash equipment, windscreen wipers and adjustable wing mirrors.

nodes.title: Propulsion control systems
nodes.definition: Refers to systems which monitor and/or control engine speed and performance.

nodes.title: Instrumentation
nodes.definition: Refers to systems (hardware/software) which monitor/report on the operation of vehicle systems. It includes, for example, the drivers instrumentation panel, warning lights and condition monitoring systems

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Framework and/or basic structural housing for a system, including load bearing components.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the vehicles primary load bearing component which provides the structural integrity to withstand the operational loading stresses generated while traversing various terrain profiles. This element could be a simple wheeled vehicle frame or a more complicated combat vehicle hull which satisfies not only the structural requirements but also provides armor protection. It includes all structural subassemblies and appendages which attach directly to the primary structure. This element, for example, includes towing and lifting fittings, bumpers, hatches and grilles. It also includes provision to accommodate other subsystems such as mountings for suspension, weapons, turret, track body, cab, special equipment, loads etc.

nodes.title: Internal mountings
nodes.definition: Refers to internal fitments mounted on the hull/frame. It includes brackets, stud welding, floors and insulation panels.

nodes.title: External mountings
nodes.definition: Refers to the chassis and external fitments mounted on the hull/frame. It includes brackets, stud welding, steps, bumpers, mud-guards, windows, etc.

nodes.title: Doors/hatches
nodes.definition: Refers to loading/entry hatches and doors in, or directly mounted on, the hull/frame assembly. It includes shell loading doors, driver and passenger doors, hatches, locks, handles, drivers/operators hoods, cowls and windshields, etc.

nodes.title: Seats
nodes.definition: Refers to seating which is directly mounted on the hull/frame.

nodes.title: Drinking water tank
nodes.definition: Refers to a system designed to provide drinking water for the driver and crew, which is directly mounted on the hull/frame. It includes tanks, filler necks, filters, pipes, seals, valves, vents, drainage, etc.

nodes.title: Access cover plates
nodes.definition: Refers to access cover plates directly mounted on the hull/frame. It includes, for example, guards, plugs, drain/inspection covers. It can also include deck area assemblies.

nodes.title: Gun crutch/depression rails
nodes.definition: Refers to gun crutch and depression rails directly mounted on the hull/frame.

nodes.title: Skirting plates/brackets/splash plates
nodes.definition: Refers to skirting plates, brackets and splash plates directly mounted on the hull/frame. It includes the plates and associated fittings, brackets, towing attachments, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The body/cab elements refer to the major components to be mated to a chassis or frame to provide a complete vehicle having a defined mission capability. This element includes accommodation for personnel, cargo, and such subsystems

nodes.title: Internal mountings
nodes.definition: Refers to internal fitments mounted on the body/cab. It includes panels, brackets, clips, fascia, instrument panels, stud welding, internal windows, etc.

nodes.title: External mountings
nodes.definition: Refers to external fitments mounted on the body/cab. It includes the external cab assembly, panels, brackets, stud welding, steps, windows, cab tilt and locking mechanism, etc.

nodes.title: Doors/hatches
nodes.definition: Refers to loading/entry hatches and doors in, or directly mounted on, the body/cab. It includes loading doors, driver and passenger doors, hatches, locks, handles, etc.

nodes.title: Seats
nodes.definition: Refers to seating and associated fittings which are directly mounted on the body/cab. It includes, for example, seat belts and harnesses.

nodes.title: Drinking water tank
nodes.definition: Refers to a system designed to provide drinking water for the driver and crew, which is directly mounted on the body/cab. It includes tanks, filler necks, filters, pipes, seals, valves, vents, drainage, etc.

nodes.title: Access panels
nodes.definition: Refers to access panels directly mounted on the body/cab.

nodes.title: Load bay
nodes.definition: Refers to load (or passenger) carrying areas in the body/cab and any soft/hard top covering, supports, etc.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls, items and associated systems in, or directly mounted on, the body or cab.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the means for generating tractive effort, thrust and lift, generally at or in proximity to the earth's surface and adapting the vehicle to the irregularities of the surface. It includes, for example, wheels, tracks and steering gears for traction and control functions. Also, it includes springs, shock absorbers, skirts and other suspension members such as track adjusting mechanisms. It does not include specific steering mechanisms.

nodes.title: Suspension unit
nodes.definition: Refers to the means for adapting the vehicle to irregularities of the surface. It includes hydrogas units, shock absorbers, leaf and coil springs, pneumatic suspension units, etc. Also included is the lift mechanism, skirts, etc, for hovercraft.

nodes.title: Road wheel hub assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for distributing the nominal ground pressure of the vehicle. On wheeled vehicles, it includes wheels that transfer tractive effort to the surface and rolling wheels. It includes road wheels, hub assemblies, tires, valves, inner-tubes, etc.

nodes.title: Sprocket wheel assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to the sprocket drive wheels which transfer tractive effort to the track.

nodes.title: Track assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to the track and associated linkages.

nodes.title: Idler wheels
nodes.definition: Refers to the feed/guide mechanism(s) associated with track laying. It includes idler wheels and track tensioners.

nodes.title: Roller assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to the track roller guide assemblies.

nodes.title: Axle
nodes.definition: Refers to non-driving axles not covered under the transmission system. It includes axle arms, links, bearings, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The turret assembly refers to the structures and equipment installation required to provide the fighting compartment element of combat vehicles. This element includes turret armor, EMC shielding, turret rings, slip rings, attachments and appendages such as latches and cupolas, and accommodation for personnel, weapons and C 3 I.

nodes.title: Internal mountings
nodes.definition: Refers to internal fitments mounted in the turret. It includes drinking water installations, periscope mountings, panels, brackets, clips, stud welding, etc.

nodes.title: External mountings
nodes.definition: Refers to external fitments mounted on the turret. It includes brush deflector assemblies, cooler boxes, gun covers, splash curtains, panels, brackets, stud welding, etc.

nodes.title: Hatches
nodes.definition: Refers to loading/entry hatches in, or directly mounted on, the turret. It includes loading hatches, crew hatches and associated locks, handles, fittings, etc. It does not include cupolas.

nodes.title: Seats
nodes.definition: Refers to seating which is directly mounted in the turret.

nodes.title: Ring assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to a circular track and roller/ball-race assembly designed to facilitate turret rotation.

nodes.title: Cupola
nodes.definition: Refers to a roof aperture and domed hatch assembly, primarily for observation purposes. It can be capable of rotation, and can also provide access for entry/exit.

nodes.title: Elevating/traversing gearbox
nodes.definition: Refers to elevating/traversing gearboxes mounted on the turret wall.

nodes.title: Turntable assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to the turret turntable assembly. It includes drive and roller assemblies, RBJ mountings, etc.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls, items and associated systems in, or directly mounted on, the turret. It includes such items as wash/wipe equipment, turret and elevation locks, position indicators and adjustable mirrors, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A defensive or offensive system or equipment.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The gun control element refers to that equipment (hardware/software) installed in the vehicle which provides intelligence necessary to power elevate and traverse the weapons systems and also to control via stabilization systems, and turret and gun drives, including gun position indicators and sensors.

nodes.title: Installation
nodes.definition: Refers to the Gun Control Equipment (GCE) installation.

nodes.title: Control panel
nodes.definition: Refers to control panels associated with FV GCE.

nodes.title: Power supply
nodes.definition: Refers to power supply units associated with FV GCE.

nodes.title: Switch units
nodes.definition: Refers to switch units associated with FV GCE. It includes trimming units, fire control switches, etc.

nodes.title: Gun controller
nodes.definition: Refers to control systems associated with GCE. It includes controls for the gun, motor generators, metadynes, amplidynes, magnicons, and power amplifiers.

nodes.title: Power motors
nodes.definition: Refers to gearbox drive motors, associated with GCE. It includes the power, elevation and traverse drive motors.

nodes.title: Gyroscope assembly
nodes.definition: Refers to gyroscope assemblies associated with GCE.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary GCE controls and associated systems. It includes such items as turnbuckle assemblies, traverse displacement units, fire control quadrants, inter-connecting boxes, wiring, connectors, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The fire control element refers to that equipment (hardware/software) installed in the vehicle which provides intelligence necessary for weapons delivery such as launching and firing. This element includes, for example, radar and other sensors necessary for search recognition, meteorological and/or tracking; controls and displays, fire control computers, and computer programs.

nodes.title: Computer/interface
nodes.definition: Refers to computer interface systems and equipment associated with fire control systems. It includes computer/interface units, program loading facilities, etc.

nodes.title: Control/monitor
nodes.definition: Refers to control and monitoring equipment associated with the fire control systems.

nodes.title: Filter units
nodes.definition: Refers to filter units associated with the fire control systems.

nodes.title: Sensors
nodes.definition: Refers to sensors associated with the fire control systems. It includes sensors for elevation and traverse displacement, trunnion tilt, sighting angle, etc.

nodes.title: Firing handles
nodes.definition: Refers to firing handles associated with the fire control systems.

nodes.title: Fire control boxes
nodes.definition: Refers to control boxes associated with the fire control system. It includes the commander's, and gunner's control boxes, the loader's safety box, etc.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary items and associated systems. It includes such items as junction boxes, cables, connectors, services, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to that equipment (hardware/software) which provides a thermal picture for the crew to use for surveillance and weapon guidance. It includes thermal imaging sensor heads, drive units, processors, power supply units, and display units.

nodes.title: Sensor
nodes.definition: Refers to sensors specifically associated with thermal imaging systems. It includes scanner head assemblies, IR telescopes, tilt sensors, focal telescopes, etc.

nodes.title: Processing
nodes.definition: Refers to processing elements associated with thermal imaging systems. It includes symbology units, processors, etc.

nodes.title: Display
nodes.definition: Refers to the display elements of a thermal imaging system. It includes binocular viewers, commander's and gunner's display units, display drive units, etc.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to the control elements of a thermal imaging system. It includes servo units, gunner's and commander's control units, etc.

nodes.title: Converter units
nodes.definition: Refers to converter elements of a thermal imaging system. It includes isolating converter units, etc.

nodes.title: Structure and framework
nodes.definition: Refers to framework and/or basic structural housing for a thermal imaging system, including load bearing components.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls, items and associated systems related to thermal imaging systems. It includes such items as wash/wipe equipment, cables, connectors, services, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to that equipment which provides a cooling medium, for thermal images. It will include, for example, compressors, bottles, pipes, fans, mini coolers, air cleaning columns and sterling cycle cooling machines.

nodes.title: Compressors
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used to pressurize the cooling system. It includes motors, pumps, etc.

nodes.title: Storage
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used for storage of coolant. It includes tanks, filling systems, sumps, drains, etc.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used for distribution of coolant. It includes pipes, valves, etc.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used to monitor the condition of coolant (quantity, temperature and pressure). It includes transmitters, indicators, wiring, warning systems, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The optical element refers to the sighting systems for search, observation, identification, tracking, range-finding and will include sensors and displays associated with this system.

nodes.title: Surveillance
nodes.definition: Refers to optical surveillance equipment. It includes such items as observation periscopes, etc.

nodes.title: Sighting
nodes.definition: Refers to optical sighting equipment. It includes such items as sighting and aiming periscopes, etc.

nodes.title: Reticle image projector
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for displaying a reticle image in/on the sighting device.

nodes.title: Sighting unit
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for displaying a reticle image in the sighting device.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls, items and associated systems related to optical sighting systems. It includes such items as wash/wipe equipment, cables, connectors, services, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The weapon/gun element refers to the means for the launcher to deliver fire on hostile targets or for logistics and other vehicles to exercise self-defense. This element includes, for example, the main gun/elevating mass and secondary armaments such as small arms and mortars. Fire control, gun control, and optical systems are excluded.

nodes.title: Barrel
nodes.definition: The barrel assembly provides initial guidance for launch of projectiles.

nodes.title: Breech, housing and firing mechanism
nodes.definition: Refers to a system which provides a means of access for the projectile/case to enter the barrel. It also provides a pressure seal and firing mechanism, together with the means by which the breech and firing mechanism are housed within the equipment. It includes all associated housing items.

nodes.title: Mountings
nodes.definition: Refers to the means for attaching the barrel assembly and can include the mountlet assembly as well as the means to balance the armament system. It also includes tripods and bipods.

nodes.title: Recoil mechanism
nodes.definition: Refers to systems which provide a means for absorbing energy created by projectile launch. It includes recuperator and recoil assemblies, etc.

nodes.title: Smoke discharger
nodes.definition: Refers to a means for dispersing smoke/fumes generated when a round is fired.

nodes.title: Secondary armaments installation
nodes.definition: Refers to systems which provide a secondary armament installation.

nodes.title: Sights
nodes.definition: Refers to a mechanical sighting system used on small arms, machine guns, man-portable launchers, etc.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary items and associated systems. It includes, for example, such items as spare barrels and other parts, wallets, cleaning kits and sustained fire kits.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The automatic loading element consists of that equipment (hardware/software) providing the means to select ammunition from a stored position in the vehicle, its transfer to and loading of the armament system. This element also includes the means to eject spent cases and misfired rounds. Components include all ammunition storage racks, transfer/lift mechanisms, ramming and ejecting mechanisms as well as specialized hydraulic and electrical controls.

nodes.title: Storage (ready round)
nodes.definition: Refers to ammunition storage racks, bins, etc.

nodes.title: Transfer/lift
nodes.definition: Refers to the means to select ammunition from a stored position in the vehicle and transfer it to the armament system. It includes transfer and lift mechanisms

nodes.title: Loading/ramming
nodes.definition: Refers to the means to loading the armament system. It includes ramming and ejecting mechanisms.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to the means to control loading the armament system. It includes specialized hydraulic and electrical controls and safety devices.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment for generation, distribution and/or control of electric power.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the electrical or electronic systems for the engine/power pack. It will include wiring harnesses, line replaceable units (LRUs), sensors, lighting, batteries, generators, etc.

nodes.title: Generating
nodes.definition: Refers to generating systems and equipment in the engine/power pack compartment that are not directly mounted on the engine/power-pack. It includes such items as alternators, dynamos, generator panels, etc.

nodes.title: Batteries
nodes.definition: Refers to battery equipment mounted in the engine/power pack compartment. It includes such items as battery containers, lagging kits, battery assemblies, connecting straps, etc.

nodes.title: Instrumentation
nodes.definition: Refers to instrumentation systems and equipment mounted in the engine/power pack compartment. It includes such items as tachometers, speedometers, indicating panels, electronic circuit panels, control transmitters, etc.

nodes.title: Lights
nodes.definition: Refers to lighting systems and equipment mounted in the engine/power pack compartment. It includes such items as inspection lights, etc.

nodes.title: Wiring
nodes.definition: Refers to wiring and cable looms mounted in the engine/power pack compartment. It includes looms, wires, harnesses, etc.

nodes.title: Electrical equipment
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical equipment mounted in the engine/power pack compartment. It includes, for example, actuators, engine controls and ignition systems.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical distribution systems and equipment mounted in the engine/power pack compartment. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: Protection
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical protection systems and equipment mounted in the engine/power pack compartment. It includes such items as fuses, fusible links, trip switches, etc.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to control systems and equipment mounted in the engine/power pack compartment. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the electrical or electronic systems for the hull and frame. It will include both internal and external wiring harnesses, junction and distribution boxes, line replaceable units (LRUs), sensors and lighting systems. It also includes the interfaces and connectors associated with the engine, power pack, generating and starting systems.

nodes.title: Internal electrical systems
nodes.definition: Refers to the internal electrical or electronic systems mounted in the hull/frame. It will include, for example, wiring harnesses, LRUs, junction and distribution boxes. It also includes the interfaces and connectors associated with the engine, power pack, generating and starting systems.

nodes.title: Batteries
nodes.definition: Refers to battery equipment related to the hull/frame. It includes such items as battery containers, lagging kits, battery assemblies, connecting straps, etc.

nodes.title: Internal lights
nodes.definition: Refers to lighting systems mounted internally in the hull/frame.

nodes.title: External electrical systems
nodes.definition: Refers to the electrical or electronic systems mounted externally on the hull/frame. It will include, for example, external lighting systems, horns and flashing beacons.

nodes.title: Wiring
nodes.definition: Refers to wiring, cable looms and clips related to the hull/frame or associated with connecting to the engine/power pack. It includes looms, wires, clips, harnesses, connectors, etc.

nodes.title: Electrical equipment
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical equipment related to the hull/frame. It includes, for example, actuators, wiper controls, heaters, cooking pots, horns, radio fittings and ancillary items.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical distribution and interconnecting systems and equipment related to the hull/frame. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: Protection
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical protection systems and equipment related to the hull/frame. It includes such items as fuses, fuse panels, fusible links, trip switches, etc.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to control systems and equipment related to the hull/frame. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the electrical or electronic systems for either the body/cab. It will include wiring harnesses, line replaceable units (LRUs), sensors and lighting systems.

nodes.title: Generating
nodes.definition: Refers to generating systems and equipment related to the body/cab. It includes such items as generator control panels, etc.

nodes.title: Batteries
nodes.definition: Refers to battery equipment related to the body/cab. It includes such items as battery containers, lagging kits, battery assemblies, connecting straps, etc.

nodes.title: Instrumentation
nodes.definition: Refers to instrumentation systems and equipment related to the body cab. It includes such items as indicating panels, electronic circuit panels, control transmitters, etc.

nodes.title: Lights
nodes.definition: Refers to lighting systems and equipment related to the body cab. It includes such items as inspection lights, head lights, spot lights, tail/side lights, indicators, panel lights, convoy lights, etc.

nodes.title: Wiring
nodes.definition: Refers to wiring and cable looms related to the body/cab. It includes looms, wires, harnesses, earthing straps, etc.

nodes.title: Electrical equipment
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical equipment related to the body/cab. It includes, for example, actuators, wiper controls, heaters, cooking pots and horns.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical distribution systems and equipment related to the body/cab. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: Protection
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical protection systems and equipment related to the body/cab. It includes such items as fuses, fuse panels, fusible links, trip switches, etc.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to control systems and equipment related to the body/cab. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the electrical or electronic systems for the turret. It will include wiring harnesses, line replaceable units (LRUs), sensors and lighting systems.

nodes.title: Generating
nodes.definition: Refers to generating systems and equipment related to the turret. It includes such items as generator control panels, etc.

nodes.title: Batteries
nodes.definition: Refers to battery equipment related to the turret. It includes such items as battery containers, lagging kits, battery assemblies, connecting straps, etc.

nodes.title: Instrumentation
nodes.definition: Refers to instrumentation systems and equipment related to the turret. It includes such items as indicating panels, electronic circuit panels, control transmitters, etc.

nodes.title: Lights
nodes.definition: Refers to lighting systems and equipment related to the turret. It includes such items as inspection lights, panel lights, roof lights, spot lights, convoy lights, etc.

nodes.title: Wiring
nodes.definition: Refers to wiring and cable looms related to the turret. It includes looms, wires, harnesses, earthing straps, etc.

nodes.title: Electrical equipment
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical equipment related to the turret. It includes, for example, actuators, wiper controls, heaters and cooking pots.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical distribution systems and equipment related to the turret. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: Protection
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical protection systems and equipment related to the turret. It includes such items as fuses, fuse panels, fusible links, trip switches, etc.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to control systems and equipment related to the turret. It includes such items as controllers, switches, relays, regulators, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment for transferring information.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The communications element refers to that equipment (hardware/software) which provides the means within the system for commanding, controlling and transmitting/receiving information and data to vehicle crew members and other personnel exterior to the operating vehicle. This element includes radio frequency equipment, microwave and optic communication links, networked equipment for multiple vehicle control and intercoms and external phones systems. It can include navigational system and data displays when these are integral with the equipment of crew stations or drivers for automotive display.

nodes.title: UHF/SHF/EHF
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system used for communications utilizing ultra, super and extra high frequency (UHF, SHF, EHF) carriers. It includes transmitters, receivers, control, antennas, etc.

nodes.title: VHF
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system used for communications utilizing very high frequency (VHF) carriers. It includes transmitters, receivers, control, antennas, etc.

nodes.title: HF
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system used for communications utilizing high frequency (HF) carriers. It includes transmitters, receivers, control, antennas, etc.

nodes.title: LF
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system used for communications utilizing low frequency (LF) carriers. It includes transmitters, receivers, control, antennas, etc.

nodes.title: Audio
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system used for voice communications. It includes such items as intercoms, headphones, loudspeakers, switching/control panels, etc.

nodes.title: Digital
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system used for digital/data communications. It includes modems, encryption devices, etc.

nodes.title: Satellite
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system used for communications via satellites. It includes transmitters, receivers, control, antennas, etc.

nodes.title: Optical
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system used for communications via line-of-site. It includes transmitters, receivers, control, signaling devices, etc.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls and associated systems. It includes such items as wiring, connectors, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: IFF equipment is common to all services and is therefore interactive with many other users. It covers the equipment (hardware software) that identifies friend or foe and transmits that information. It can use the vehicle communication system(s).

nodes.title: Transmitting
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the system which is used to send data.

nodes.title: Receiving
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the system which is used to receive IFF data.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the system which is used to display IFF data.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to determine, conduct, manage or plot a position or course for the system.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The navigation element refers to that equipment (hardware/software) installed in the vehicle which permits the crew to determine vehicle location and to plot the course of the vehicle. It includes navigation systems such as dead reckoning, inertial and global positioning systems. Landmark recognition algorithms and processors are also included.

nodes.title: Independent
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system (hardware/software) which provides information to determine position and is independent on ground installations or orbiting satellites. It includes inertial guidance systems, tracking systems, sextants, etc.

nodes.title: Dependant
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system (hardware/software) which provides information to determine position and is mainly dependant on ground installations or orbiting satellites. It includes GPS, radio compass, etc.

nodes.title: Computing
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the system (hardware/software) which combines/processes navigational data to compute or manage the vehicle's geographical position. It includes course computers, landmark recognition algorithms, processors, displays, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to sense the environment.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The surveillance element is defined as all equipment (hardware/software) and associated systems used to sense the surrounding environment and then process, display and record the resulting information. This can include, for example, Meteorological equipment. It does not include specific thermal imaging or meteorological/atmospheric systems.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to the processing, control and recording elements of the sensor systems. It includes central processors, analogue/digital converters, associated software, storage units, etc.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used to indicate/monitor sensor information. It includes data identification, indicators, displays panels, etc.

nodes.title: Recording
nodes.definition: Refers to the part of the system used to record sensor information.

nodes.title: Optical/infra-red
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system that uses optical and/or heat-sensing devices to acquire information. It includes, for example, driver’s, commander’s and gunner’s periscopes, infra-red scanners, heat sensors and image intensifiers. It does not include specific thermal imaging systems or sighting equipment.

nodes.title: Laser
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system that uses laser devices to acquire information. It includes distance measuring, target identification, etc.

nodes.title: Radar
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system that uses radar devices to acquire information. It includes antennas, receivers, transmitters, indicators, etc.

nodes.title: Magnetic
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system that uses magnetic sensors to acquire information. It includes magnetometers, amplifiers, processors, indicators, etc.

nodes.title: Sonar
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system that uses sonar to acquire information. It includes modulators, transducers, processors, indicators, etc.

nodes.title: Acoustic
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system that uses sound to acquire information. It includes listening devices, amplifiers, processors, indicators, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to the systems and devices which furnish a means of providing, processing and recording meteorological data.

nodes.title: Weather
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system which is used to detect, measure, process or record weather (moisture, temperature, cloud, wind, etc) data. It includes hygrometers, thermometers, anemometers, etc.

nodes.title: Air turbulence
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system which is used to detect, measure, process or record air turbulence data.

nodes.title: Pollutants
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system which is used to detect, measure, process or record contaminated particles.

nodes.title: Magnetic/gravitational
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of a system which is used to detect, measure, process or record the earth's magnetic or gravitational forces.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to guide or govern direction.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to the devices (hardware/software) which are part of the vehicle not contained within the suspension system or driver controls that govern the vehicle's direction. This will include, for example, rudder and thrust devices and trim valves for amphibians.

nodes.title: Rudders
nodes.definition: Refers to rudder devices designed to control the vehicle's direction.

nodes.title: Trim valves
nodes.definition: Refers to trim valves designed to control the vehicle's direction.

nodes.title: Thrusters
nodes.definition: Refers to thrust devices designed to control the vehicle's direction.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to provide a controlled environment.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to those subassemblies or components which provide a micro-climatic condition (heating or cooling), inside the vehicle, including personnel heating/cooling suits or components. It also covers purification systems not covered by NBC.

nodes.title: Compression
nodes.definition: That portion of the system and its controls which supplies pressurized air/gas. Includes items such as controls and indicating systems related to pressure, gas-filled systems, etc.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: That portion of the system used to induct and distribute air. It includes equipment rack cooling, seals, demisting, waveguide pressurization system and items of such systems, like blowers, ducting and inlets.

nodes.title: Heating
nodes.definition: That portion of the system and its controls which supply heated air. It includes items such as heater units, wiring, etc.

nodes.title: Cooling
nodes.definition: That portion of the system and its controls which supply cooled air. Includes items such as the cooling unit, indicating systems related to the cooler operation, wiring etc. It does not include temperature control and indicating systems.

nodes.title: Temperature control
nodes.definition: That portion of the system used to control the temperature of the air. Includes items such as, thermal sensing devices, switches, indicators, wiring etc.

nodes.title: Moisture/air
nodes.definition: That portion of the system used to contaminant control moisture in the air, to control ozone concentrations, to filter radioactive debris and chemical/biological contaminants, etc.

nodes.title: Liquid coolant
nodes.definition: Those components required to supply liquid coolant to a cooling system.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment for generation, distribution and/or control of hydraulic (or pneumatic) power.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to a system or equipment (hardware/software) within the vehicle for the generation, distribution and/or control of hydraulic power.

nodes.title: Main
nodes.definition: Refers to a system or equipment which is used to generate, store, distribute or control hydraulic power. It includes such items as tanks, valves, pumps, oil coolers, plumbing, etc. It does not include user systems classified elsewhere, or their connecting valves.

nodes.title: Auxiliary
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of the hydraulic system which is classified as auxiliary, emergency or standby and which is used to supplement, or replace the main hydraulic system.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the hydraulic system which is used to monitor the condition of the hydraulic system or fluid. It includes transmitters, indicators, warning systems, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to a system or equipment (hardware/software) within the vehicle for the generation, distribution and or control of pneumatic (including vacuum) power.

nodes.title: Main
nodes.definition: Refers to a system or equipment which is used to generate, store, distribute or control pneumatic power. It includes such items as tanks, valves, pumps, plumbing, etc. It does not include user systems classified elsewhere, or their connecting valves.

nodes.title: Auxiliary
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the pneumatic system which is classified as auxiliary, emergency or standby and which is used to supplement, or replace the main pneumatic system.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the pneumatic system which is used to monitor the condition of the system. It includes transmitters, indicators, warning systems, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment using electronic/automated software and/or firmware elements not specifically included in other systems.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to a system or equipment within the vehicle which uses electronic/automated software and/or firmware elements not specifically included in any other systems.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Subsidiary systems that provide services or support to main systems or equipment.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to subsidiary systems (hardware/software) that provide services or support to main systems or equipment within the vehicle, not covered elsewhere.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to provide hazard detection, protection, survivability and escape facilities.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to systems (hardware/software) that provide a warning to the crew that a possible fire hazard exists. It includes the suppression/fire fighting and heat sensors required for this system.

nodes.title: Detecting
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the system which is used to sense the presence of excessive heat, smoke or fire.

nodes.title: Indicating
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the system which is used to indicate the presence of excessive heat, smoke or fire.

nodes.title: Extinguishing
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the system, either fixed or portable, which is used to extinguish fire.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The NBC element refers to those subassemblies or components which provide nuclear, biological and chemical detection, protection and survivability to the vehicle or crew, either individually or collectively, during an NBC attack. This includes a positive pressure system, purification system, ventilated face piece (mask), NBC detection and warning devices, decontamination equipment and chemical resistant coatings. It can also include environmental control equipment, such as heaters, coolers, etc.

nodes.title: Pack
nodes.definition: Refers to NBC protection packs.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to NBC protection controls.

nodes.title: Pressure relief
nodes.definition: Refers to pressure relief devices specifically fitted for NBC protection purposes.

nodes.title: Door assemblies
nodes.definition: Refers to NBC protection fitted to doors and hatches.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary controls and associated systems. It can include, for example, such items as wiring, connectors, heaters, coolers and ducting.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to provide a special mission capability.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to that special equipment (hardware/software) to be mated to a hull/turret or to a chassis/frame/body/cab assembly, to enable the achievement of a special mission capability. It includes blades, booms, cranes, winches, robotic arms, manipulators, etc.

nodes.title: Structure
nodes.definition: Refers to that special hardware to be mated to a main assembly (hull, turret, chassis, frame, body or cab). It can include, for example, slide and tilt frames, launch frames and their winches, launch rails, bipods and platforms.

nodes.title: Electrical systems
nodes.definition: Refers to electrical systems associated with special hardware that is mated to a main assembly. It can include, for example, launch/recovery mechanism electrical systems.

nodes.title: Hydraulics
nodes.definition: Refers to hydraulic systems associated with special hardware that is mated to a main assembly. It can include, for example, the generation, distribution and control systems.

nodes.title: Handling equipment
nodes.definition: Refers to handling equipment or systems that are mated to a main assembly. It can include, for example, cranes, winches, base stabilizers, support tools and actuators.

nodes.title: Ancillary
nodes.definition: Refers to ancillary equipment for a system that is mated to a main assembly. It can include, for example, cradles, special tools, lifting beams and restraints.

nodes.title: Stowage
nodes.definition: Refers to stowage provisions for operational equipment that are provided on a main assembly.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to that special recovery equipment (hardware/software) to be mated to a hull turret or to a chassis/frame/body/cab assembly, to enable the achievement of a recovery capability. It includes cranes and towing equipment.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to that special fit equipment (hardware/software) to be mated to a hull/turret or to a chassis/frame/body/cab assembly, to enable the achievement of a specialized capability. It will include supply, DROPS, lift trucks, side loaders, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to that special-to-purpose equipment (hardware/software) to be mated to a hull/turret or to a chassis/frame/body/cab assembly, for the achievement of a special mission purpose. It covers, for example, ISO container bodies and equipment for command or repair workshop, medical and other special purpose vehicles.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A function or equipment used to provide habitability, operability or stowage facilities that is not specifically included in other systems.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element is required to provide for personal equipment stowage as well as operational equipment stowage on the vehicle including hull and turret.

nodes.title: Charge bin
nodes.definition: Refers to charge bin stowage facilities.

nodes.title: Shell stowage
nodes.definition: Refers to shell stowage facilities.

nodes.title: Ammunition
nodes.definition: Refers to stowage facilities for both secondary and personal ammunition.

nodes.title: Body/cab internal
nodes.definition: Refers to stowage facilities within the body or cab.

nodes.title: Body/cab external
nodes.definition: Refers to stowage facilities mounted on the body or cab.

nodes.title: Hull/frame internal
nodes.definition: Refers to stowage facilities mounted internally to the hull or frame. It includes, for example, the drivers, fighting, crew and engine/transmission compartments.

nodes.title: Hull/frame external
nodes.definition: Refers to stowage facilities mounted externally on the hull or frame.

nodes.title: Turret internal
nodes.definition: Refers to stowage facilities mounted internally to the turret.

nodes.title: Turret external
nodes.definition: Refers to stowage facilities mounted externally on the turret.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to lists detailing the equipment required by the user to operate and maintain the system. It includes, for example, both fitted and loose items, spares, tools and operator manuals.

nodes.title: Production ces
nodes.definition: This element refers to the production version of the CES.

nodes.title: Service ces
nodes.definition: This element refers to the service version of the CES.

nodes.title: Complex ces
nodes.definition: This element refers to the complex version of the CES.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The training element is defined as the deliverable training services, devices, accessories, aids, equipment and facilities used to provide instruction through which personnel will acquire sufficient concepts, skills and aptitudes to both operate and maintain the system with maximum efficiency. This element includes all effort associated design, development and production of deliverable training equipment as well as the execution of training services.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The training services element refers to the deliverable training services, used to provide instruction through which personnel will acquire sufficient concepts, skills and aptitudes to both operate and maintain the system with maximum efficiency.

nodes.title: Devices/accessories/aids
nodes.definition: The training devices/accessories/aids element refers to the deliverable devices, accessories and aids used to provide instruction through which personnel will acquire sufficient concepts, skills and aptitudes to both operate and maintain the system with maximum efficiency.

nodes.title: Equipment
nodes.definition: The training equipment element refers to the deliverable training equipment used to provide instruction through which personnel will acquire sufficient concepts, skills and aptitudes to both operate and maintain the system with maximum efficiency.

nodes.title: Facilities
nodes.definition: The training facilities element refers to the deliverable training facilities used to provide instruction through which personnel will acquire sufficient concepts, skills and aptitudes to both operate and maintain the system with maximum efficiency.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system, equipment or facilities used to maintain operational capability.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to a facility which will allow unserviceable vehicle power packs to be repaired, including major assembly exchange, tested and returned to service use. PPRFs can be transportable and will include tools, jigs and fixtures commensurate with the type of equipment they are due to repair.

nodes.title: Mobile
nodes.definition: This element refers to a mobile facility which will allow unserviceable vehicle power packs to be repaired, including major assembly exchange, tested and returned to service use. This section will not include the basic container body and its associated equipment.

nodes.title: Fixed
nodes.definition: This element refers to a static facility which will allow unserviceable vehicle power packs to be repaired, including major assembly exchange, tested and returned to service use.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to equipment (hardware/software) that enables the repair, test or calibration of the optical sighting equipment, including laser range finders for example.

nodes.title: Mobile
nodes.definition: Refers to mobile (man-portable or vehicle mounted) equipment (hardware/software), which can be in a vehicle container or box body, that enables the repair, test and/or calibration of optical sighting equipment.

nodes.title: Fixed
nodes.definition: Refers to static (permanent or temporary) equipment (hardware/software) that enables the repair, test or calibration of optical sighting equipment.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: To provide a transportable facility (hardware/software) whereby thermal imaging equipment including its associated cooling systems can be repaired, tested and returned to service. The equipment covered will include, for example, clean air equipment, jigs, fixtures, computer interface adapters and test equipment.

nodes.title: Mobile
nodes.definition: Refers to mobile (man-portable or vehicle mounted) equipment (hardware/software), which can be in a vehicle container or box body, that enables the repair, test and/or calibration of thermal imaging equipment.

nodes.title: Fixed
nodes.definition: Refers to static (permanent or temporary) equipment (hardware/software) that enables the repair, test or calibration of thermal imaging equipment.

nodes.title: General purpose electronic repair facility, General
General
nodes.definition: This element refers to equipment (hardware/software) that enables unserviceable electrical/electronic items to be repaired, tested and returned to service use.

nodes.title: Mobile
nodes.definition: Refers to mobile (man-portable or vehicle mounted) equipment (hardware/software), which can be in a vehicle container or box body, that enables the repair, test and/r calibration of general purpose electronic equipment.

nodes.title: Fixed
nodes.definition: Refers to static (permanent or temporary) equipment (hardware/software) that enables the repair, test or calibration of general purpose electronic equipment.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The common support equipment element refers to those items required to support and maintain the system or portions of the systems while not directly engaged in the performance of its mission, and which are presently in the MOD inventory for support of other systems. This element includes all efforts required to assure the availability of this equipment for support of the particular defense product item. It also includes the acquisition of additional quantities of this equipment if caused by the introduction of the defense material item into operational service.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment for producing and delivering power.

nodes.title: Main propulsion drives, General
nodes.definition: The propulsion prime mover. It includes, for example, nuclear, electrical, steam, gas turbine and diesel primary propulsion drives.

nodes.title: Propulsion nuclear
nodes.definition: A nuclear fuelled propulsion prime mover

nodes.title: Propulsion electrical
nodes.definition: An electrically powered propulsion prime mover.

nodes.title: Propulsion steam
nodes.definition: A propulsion prime mover driven by steam. It includes, for example, boilers, hoppers and turbines.

nodes.title: Propulsion gas turbine
nodes.definition: A gas turbine powered propulsion prime mover.

nodes.title: Propulsion diesel
nodes.definition: A propulsion prime mover fuelled by diesel.

nodes.title: Secondary propulsion drives, General
nodes.definition: A secondary means of providing propulsion.

nodes.title: Emergency propulsion drives, General
nodes.definition: An emergency means of providing propulsion.

nodes.title: Propulsion transmission systems, General
nodes.definition: A system that transmits torque (main/secondary/emergency) to the platform’s propulsion drive.

nodes.title: Propulsion gearing
nodes.definition: A system that converts torque, speed or rotational direction between the propulsion and the drive system.

nodes.title: Propulsion clutches and couplings
nodes.definition: A system that connects or removes the drive from the propulsion system.

nodes.title: Propulsion shafting
nodes.definition: A means of transmitting drive from the propulsion system.

nodes.title: Propulsion bearings
nodes.definition: A means of support for propulsion shafting.

nodes.title: Propulsion propulsors/propellers
nodes.definition: A means of converting propulsion energy into movement of the platform.

nodes.title: Propulsion support systems, General
nodes.definition: Ancillary systems in support of a platforms prime mover.

nodes.title: Circulating and cooling systems
nodes.definition: This system includes cooling air ducting, coolant pumps, liquid filled radiators, fans and associated heat exchange equipment.

nodes.title: Uptakes and down takes
nodes.definition: Refers to a system which supplies and filters air to the propulsion system and collects and removes exhaust gases from the propulsion system. It includes, for example, funnels, all filters, pipes, couplings, silencers, catalytic converters, ducting and combustion air systems.

nodes.title: Propulsion fuel systems
nodes.definition: Equipment to provide fuel storage facilities, fuel filters, delivery pipes, drainage and cut-off valves, Fuel Injector Pumps (FIP) and injectors.

nodes.title: Propulsion lubricating systems
nodes.definition: This system includes lubrication storage facilities. It includes delivery and return pipes, sumps and heat exchangers.

nodes.title: Propulsion lubrication transfer and purification
nodes.definition: This system includes lubrication pumps and filters.

nodes.title: Propulsion control systems, General
nodes.definition: Systems designed to control the various propulsion modes of a platform.

nodes.title: Propulsion control systems automatic
nodes.definition: Refers to those systems that automatically control propulsion.

nodes.title: Propulsion control systems manual
nodes.definition: Refers to those systems that manually control propulsion.

nodes.title: Propulsion control systems - Alarms (General)
nodes.definition: Systems that are designed to provide alarms on propulsion systems.

nodes.title: Automatically control propulsion - Alarms
nodes.definition: Refers to those systems that automatically control propulsion.

nodes.title: Manually control propulsion - Alarms
nodes.definition: Refers to those systems that manually control propulsion.

nodes.title: Propulsion control systems - Data logging (General)
nodes.definition: Systems designed to control the various propulsion modes of a platform.

nodes.title: Automatically control propulsion - Data logging
nodes.definition: Refers to data logger systems of automatically controlled propulsion.

nodes.title: Manually control propulsion - Data logging
nodes.definition: Refers to data logger systems of manually controlled propulsion.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Framework and/or basic structural housing for a system, including load bearing components.

nodes.title: Hull, General
nodes.definition: Structured contained envelope providing the overall platform for systems, weapons and personnel.

nodes.title: Hull fittings
nodes.definition: Fittings that are permanently attached to the hull of a platform.

nodes.title: Hydrofoils
nodes.definition: A structure designed to raise the hull out of the water when in motion enabling it to travel fast and economically.

nodes.title: Main supporting structures, General
nodes.definition: Beams and columns that provide support for load bearing decks/bulkheads.

nodes.title: Transverse frames
nodes.definition: Refers to a frame that runs athwart ships.

nodes.title: Longitudinal frames
nodes.definition: Refers to a frame that runs fore and aft.

nodes.title: Superstructure
nodes.definition: Refers to a structure that is above deck level. This does not include masts, towers, derricks etc.

nodes.title: Special structures, General
nodes.definition: Structures that are not main supporting but are integral to platform design (eg, sonar domes).

nodes.title: Structural castings, forgings and welding
nodes.definition: Refers to castings, forging and welding which form part of the structure.

nodes.title: Ballistic plating, sonar domes and stacks
nodes.definition: Refers to armour plating, covers for sonar sensors and funnels.

nodes.title: Special purpose closures and structures
nodes.definition: Refers to other structures not covered above.

nodes.title: Bulkheads/decks, General
nodes.definition: Vertical/horizontal structures, which divide the interior of the hull into compartments or spaces with provision for personnel/stores access.

nodes.title: Watertight/non watertight bulkheads
nodes.definition: Refers to all bulkheads.

nodes.title: Main decks
nodes.definition: Refers to all main decks.

nodes.title: Floors
nodes.definition: Refers to a deck in a land-based structure.

nodes.title: Masts, General
nodes.definition: Exterior vertical structures which carry those items of equipment (or stores) which by their nature require to be given height well above the deck areas of the platform.

nodes.title: Submarine masts and periscope integration
nodes.definition: Refers to masts and periscopes fitted to a submarine.

nodes.title: Fixed masts
nodes.definition: Refers to solid structures that are fixed to a superstructure.

nodes.title: Service platforms
nodes.definition: Refers to service platforms that are mounted on masts.

nodes.title: Towers
nodes.definition: Refers to lattice (mast type) structures.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to interior and exterior access points.

nodes.title: Doors
nodes.definition: Refers to hinged or sliding covers for access points in a bulkhead. May be Watertight and/or Airtight.

nodes.title: Hatches
nodes.definition: Refers to square or rectangular access point in the deck. May be Watertight and/or Airtight

nodes.title: Scuttles
nodes.definition: Refers to round watertight openings and covers in a bulkhead.

nodes.title: Covers
nodes.definition: Refers to something that protects hatches or scuttles. May be Watertight and/or Airtight.

nodes.title: Portable Plates
nodes.definition: Refers to Removable Plates and/or Panels which are integral parts of the ships structure that are secured with bolts and/or screws to allow access for maintenance.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A defensive or offensive system or equipment.

nodes.title: Gun systems, General
nodes.definition: An integrated system for platform protection and destruction of the aggressor. Additionally will include Small Arms for personal protection and aggression.

nodes.title: Gun mountings
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of a weapons system that secures the barrel/breach assembly.

nodes.title: Directors
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of a weapon system that allows for aiming of the gun.

nodes.title: Ancillaries
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of a weapon system that is not described above.

nodes.title: Small arms
nodes.definition: Refers to personal weapon systems.

nodes.title: Portable weapons
nodes.definition: Refers to portable weapon systems.

nodes.title: Guided missile systems, General
nodes.definition: Equipment to deliver a self propelled warhead that can be guided through its flight to a target.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the guided weapon system that provides control.

nodes.title: Aerials
nodes.definition: Refers to the aerials of the guided weapon system.

nodes.title: Radars
nodes.definition: Refers to the target acquisition and guidance radar equipment within the guided weapon system.

nodes.title: Launchers
nodes.definition: Refers to the launching equipment within the guided weapon system.

nodes.title: Ancillaries
nodes.definition: Refers to all parts of the guided weapon system not described above.

nodes.title: Rocket systems and pyrotechnics, General
nodes.definition: Projectiles which are used as an aid, signal or illumination.

nodes.title: Signals
nodes.definition: Refers to those projectiles used for signaling.

nodes.title: Aircraft related weapon systems, General
nodes.definition: For protection in the surveillance role and additionally equipment to provide the ability to deliver/fire weapons to selected targets.

nodes.title: Aircraft weapon systems
nodes.definition: Refers to weapon systems mounted on an aircraft.

nodes.title: Aircraft weapon control
nodes.definition: Refers to the control system of an aircraft mounted weapon system.

nodes.title: Fire control systems, General
nodes.definition: Equipment provided to fire weapons according to the protection or aggression scenario.

nodes.title: Weapon direction systems and sights
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of a weapon system that directs fire to a given target.

nodes.title: Gun fire control systems
nodes.definition: Refers to the control system of a weapon system.

nodes.title: Missile fire control systems
nodes.definition: Refers to the fire control systems for missiles.

nodes.title: Underwater fire control systems
nodes.definition: Refers to fire control systems for underwater weapon Systems.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The equipment provided for the discharge of torpedoes to their targets in a timely and controlled manner.

nodes.title: Submarine torpedo systems
nodes.definition: Refers to the submarine torpedo systems.

nodes.title: Surface launch torpedo equipment
nodes.definition: Refers to the surface launch systems for torpedoes.

nodes.title: Torpedo handling and stowage
nodes.definition: Refers to the handling and stowage facilities for torpedoes.

nodes.title: Acoustic
nodes.definition: That portion of the system that uses sound to acquire information. It includes listening devices, amplifiers, processors, indicators etc

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Those units and components which furnish a means of detecting, analyzing, jamming, or nullifying the effectiveness of defensive detection devices and communication links.

nodes.title: Active
nodes.definition: That portion of the system consisting of receivers, transmitters, repeaters, blanking and modulating devices (eg, infra-red, laser).

nodes.title: Passive
nodes.definition: That portion of the system that contains no active elements (eg, chaff).

nodes.title: Data processing
nodes.definition: That portion of the system that processes and analyses received data.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment for generation, distribution and/or control of electric power.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Power produced to satisfy all electrical power requirements using a generator driven by a prime mover.

nodes.title: Turbo generators and control equipment
nodes.definition: Refers to the control equipment for turbo generators.

nodes.title: Gas turbine generators and control equipment
nodes.definition: Refers to the control equipment for gas turbine generators.

nodes.title: Diesel generators and control equipment
nodes.definition: Refers to the control equipment for diesel generators.

nodes.title: Motor generators
nodes.definition: Refers to motor generators.

nodes.title: Primary supply and distribution systems, General
General
nodes.definition: Refers to the primary supply and distribution systems of electrical power.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to the converted electrical power supplies.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Lighting equipment that is powered from the mains electrical distribution systems.

nodes.title: Cabling
nodes.definition: Refers to the cabling used in electrical power systems.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The equipment that provides alternative/back-up electrical supplies for use with certain electrical circuits in the event of a power failure.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Emergency supply systems for use in the event of 'normal' power supply failure.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Systems designed to provide safe and effective control of electrical power requirements.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Static and limited (dc) electrical power sources used to provide main, secondary, emergency and/or back-up supplies, additionally to provide supplies to certain portable electrical equipment.

nodes.title: Primary batteries
nodes.definition: Refers to all primary batteries.

nodes.title: Secondary batteries
nodes.definition: Refers to all secondary batteries.

nodes.title: Battery charging systems
nodes.definition: Refers to the charging systems for all batteries.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The communications element refers to that equipment fitted to a platform which provides the means to receive information from off-ship source, to transmit to off-ship receivers and to distribute information throughout the ship.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The shipboard communications system/equipment using super and extra high frequency carriers.

nodes.title: Aerials
nodes.definition: Refers to the SHF/EHF aerials used in a communications system.

nodes.title: Aerial multi-couplers and tuners
nodes.definition: Refers to the aerial multi-couplers and tuners of an SHF/EHF communications system.

nodes.title: Receivers
nodes.definition: Refers to the receiver equipment of an SHF/EHF communications system.

nodes.title: Transmitters
nodes.definition: Refers to the transmitter equipment of an SHF/EHF communications system.

nodes.title: Transceivers
nodes.definition: Refers to the transceiver equipment of an SHF/EHF communications system.

nodes.title: Ancillaries
nodes.definition: Refers to all parts of an SHF/EHF communications system not detailed above. It includes, for example, patching facilities, modems and other ancillary equipment.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The shipboard communications system/equipment using very high frequency carriers.

nodes.title: Aerials
nodes.definition: Refers to the UHF/VHF aerials used in a communications system.

nodes.title: Aerial multi-couplers and tuners
nodes.definition: Refers to the aerial multi-couplers and tuners of a UHF/VHF communications system.

nodes.title: Receivers
nodes.definition: Refers to the receiver equipment of a UHF/VHF communications system.

nodes.title: Transmitters
nodes.definition: Refers to the transmitter equipment of a UHF/VHF communications system.

nodes.title: Transceivers
nodes.definition: Refers to the transceiver equipment of a UHF/VHF communications system.

nodes.title: Ancillaries
nodes.definition: Refers to all parts of a UHF/VHF communications system not detailed above. It includes, for example, patching facilities, modems and other ancillary equipment.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The communication system/equipment using high and medium frequency carriers.

nodes.title: Aerials
nodes.definition: Refers to the HF/MF aerials used in a communications system.

nodes.title: Aerial multi-couplers and tuners
nodes.definition: Refers to the aerial multi-couplers and tuners of an HF/MF communications system.

nodes.title: Receivers
nodes.definition: Refers to the receiver equipment of an HF/MF communications system.

nodes.title: Transmitters
nodes.definition: Refers to the transmitter equipment of an HF/MF communications system.

nodes.title: Transceivers
nodes.definition: Refers to the transceiver equipment of an HF/MF communications system.

nodes.title: Ancillaries
nodes.definition: Refers to all parts of an HF/MF communications system not detailed above. It includes, for example, patching facilities, modems and other ancillary equipment.

nodes.title: LF/VLF, General
nodes.definition: The shipboard communications system/equipment using low and very low frequency carriers.

nodes.title: Aerials
nodes.definition: Refers to the LF/VLF aerials used in a communications system.

nodes.title: Aerial multi-couplers and tuners
nodes.definition: Refers to the aerial multi-couplers and tuners of an LF/VLF communications system.

nodes.title: Receivers
nodes.definition: Refers to the receiver equipment of an LF/VLF communications system.

nodes.title: Transmitters
nodes.definition: Refers to the transmitter equipment of an LF/VLF communications system.

nodes.title: Transceivers
nodes.definition: Refers to the transceiver equipment of an LF/VLF communications system.

nodes.title: Ancillaries
nodes.definition: Refers to all parts of an LF/VLF communications system not detailed above. It includes, for example, patching facilities, modems and other ancillary equipment.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The shipboard communications system/equipment that is used for integration distribution and control of communications.

nodes.title: Control outfits
nodes.definition: Refers to the control equipment for the shipboard communications system.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The shipboard communications system/equipment that is used for digital data transmission and reception. It includes, for example, modems, encryption devices and teletypes.

nodes.title: Cryptographic receivers
nodes.definition: Refers to the receiver encryption devices.

nodes.title: Cryptographic transmitters
nodes.definition: Refers to the transmitter encryption devices.

nodes.title: Teletype/message handling
nodes.definition: Refers to the teletype and message handling devices that form part of the shipboard communications system.

nodes.title: Tele-printers
nodes.definition: Refers to the tele-printers used in a shipboard communications system

nodes.title: Modems
nodes.definition: Refers to the modems used in a shipboard communications system.

nodes.title: Displays
nodes.definition: Refers to the visual display equipment used in a shipboard communications system.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The shipboard communications system/equipment that provides communications within the confines of the platform.

nodes.title: Broadcasts
nodes.definition: Refers to the shipboard broadcasting and public address systems.

nodes.title: Inter-communication
