nodes.definition: Refers to the shipboard intercommunications system.

nodes.title: Networks
nodes.definition: Refers to all shipboard networks. It includes, for example, Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), etc.

nodes.title: Recreational
nodes.definition: Refers to all shipboard domestic electronic devices. It includes, for example, radios, televisions and video recorders, etc.

nodes.title: Alarms
nodes.definition: Refers to the shipboard alarm systems.

nodes.title: Control
nodes.definition: Refers to the control equipment used for shipboard communications systems.

nodes.title: Telephones
nodes.definition: Refers to the telephone equipment used on shipboard communications systems.

nodes.title: Flight control and instrument landing systems, General
General
nodes.definition: Communication equipment provided for the safe take-off, operation and landing of aircraft.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to determine, conduct, manage or plot a position or course for the system.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to the navigation equipment fitted to a platform that is independent of ground stations and orbiting satellites (eg, NATO SINS, compasses, Log Systems, wind gear).

nodes.title: Gyro compasses
nodes.definition: Refers to compasses using gyro principles.

nodes.title: Magnetic compasses
nodes.definition: Refers to all compasses using magnetic principles.

nodes.title: Inertial
nodes.definition: Refers to all aspects of inertial navigation. It includes, for example, inertial platforms and gyroscope assemblies, etc.

nodes.title: Speed and distance
nodes.definition: Ship speed and distance systems.

nodes.title: Depth
nodes.definition: Refers to shipboard depth determining systems.

nodes.title: Wind speed and direction
nodes.definition: Systems to measure and indicate wind speed and direction. It includes, for example, standard wind gear and lightweight wind gear.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to the navigation equipment fitted to a platform that is dependent on ground stations and orbiting satellites. It includes, for example, Global Positioning System, Hyper fix, etc.

nodes.title: Satellite
nodes.definition: Refers to the satellite navigation equipment fitted to a platform.

nodes.title: Radio
nodes.definition: Refers to the radio navigation equipment fitted to a platform.

nodes.title: Radar
nodes.definition: Refers to the radar navigation equipment fitted to a platform.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to the navigation equipment fitted to a platform which combines/processes navigational data to compute or manage the platforms geographical position. It includes the ship data distribution systems.

nodes.title: Plotting
nodes.definition: Refers to those navigational aids used for plotting.

nodes.title: Data distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to that equipment used for the distribution of navigational data.

nodes.title: Data retransmission
nodes.definition: Refers to the equipment used for the retransmission of navigational data.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to that portion of equipment fitted to a platform which senses, monitors and, where required provides alarms and environmental data. It includes, for example, radar, sonar, thermal, optical and environmental technologies.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the surveillance equipment fitted to a platform that processes and controls the sensor systems. It includes combat systems.

nodes.title: Data processing
nodes.definition: Refers to the equipment used for the processing surveillance data.

nodes.title: Displays
nodes.definition: Refers to that equipment used to visually display surveillance data.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the surveillance equipment fitted to a platform that uses radar devices to acquire information. It includes, for example, aerial outfits and surveillance radar.

nodes.title: Aerials
nodes.definition: Refers to the aerials used as part of radar surveillance.

nodes.title: Receiver
nodes.definition: Refers to the receiver equipment used as part of radar surveillance.

nodes.title: Transmitter
nodes.definition: Refers to the transmitter equipment used as part of radar surveillance.

nodes.title: Ancillaries
nodes.definition: Refers to the ancillary equipment used as part of radar surveillance.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to the equipment used to distribute radar surveillance data.

nodes.title: Displays
nodes.definition: Refers to the equipment used to visually display radar surveillance data.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the surveillance equipment fitted to a platform that uses sonar devices to acquire information

nodes.title: Transducers
nodes.definition: Refers to the transducers used as part of sonar surveillance.

nodes.title: Receiver
nodes.definition: Refers to the receiver equipment used as part of sonar surveillance.

nodes.title: Transmitter
nodes.definition: Refers to the transmitter equipment used as part of sonar surveillance.

nodes.title: Ancillaries
nodes.definition: Refers to the ancillary equipment used as part of sonar surveillance.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.definition: Refers to the equipment used to distribute radar sonar data.

nodes.title: Displays
nodes.definition: Refers to the equipment used to visually display sonar surveillance data.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the surveillance equipment fitted to a platform that is used to detect and identify EM emissions.

nodes.title: ESM aerials
nodes.definition: Refers to aerials used for Electronic Surveillance Measures (ESM).

nodes.title: ESM receivers
nodes.definition: Refers to receivers used for Electronic Surveillance Measures (ESM).

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the surveillance equipment fitted to a platform that uses optical devices to acquire information. It includes, for example, periscopes and GPEOD.

nodes.title: Thermal imaging
nodes.definition: This element refers to that equipment (hardware/software) which provides a thermal picture surveillance and weapon guidance. It includes thermal imaging sensor heads, drive units, processors, sights, power supply units, and display units.

nodes.title: Periscopes
nodes.definition: Refers to the periscopes used as part of the optical surveillance equipment.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to that part of the surveillance equipment fitted to a platform that provides data transfer capabilities. It includes, for example, data highways and combat system highways.

nodes.title: Data highway
nodes.definition: Refers to the digital data busses used as part of the surveillance system.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Surveillance equipment provided for the selection and identification of friendly and hostile targets.

nodes.title: Radar aerials
nodes.definition: Refers to the radar aerials used as part of the identification system.

nodes.title: Integrators transponders
nodes.definition: Refers to the shipboard, built-in transponders used as part of the identification system of the surveillance system.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to those units and devices within the platform which govern movement and/or direction of assemblies. It includes, for example, motors, gearboxes, drives, thrusters and rudders.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The system designed to transmit the requirements given at the steering position, to the receiver that controls the movements of the rudders or other steering mechanisms.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Power units fitted in the ship below the surface to give lateral thrust when maneuvering the ship.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The equipment provided to minimize the effect of wave movement on a ship.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The system designed to control the submerged depth of a submersible

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Equipment provided to control the attitude of a submersible underwater.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to provide a controlled environment

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Equipment provided to control climatic/environmental conditions within a given space.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Air supply and exhaust systems which provide habitable conditions in working and living spaces within a platform.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Systems which control the humidity and temperature of living spaces, and some working spaces within a platform.

nodes.title: Compartment heating systems
nodes.definition: That portion of the system and its controls which supply heat. It includes items such as heater units, wiring, etc.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A machinery plant that generates oxygen which can be stored in liquid or gaseous form.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment for generation, distribution and/or control of hydraulic power.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Equipment required to provide fluidic power for a prime mover/requirement.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Equipment required to provide fluidic power for the control of engineering systems and machinery.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Systems that are designed to move and store air under pressure.

nodes.title: Servo air systems
nodes.definition: Systems that move under air under pressure.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment using electronic/automated software and/or firmware elements not included in other systems.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system that uses electrolysis for the protection of a ships hull against wastage caused by the corrosive effect of salt water.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system designed to neutralize the magnetic field surrounding a platform.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Subsidiary systems that provide services or support to main systems or equipment.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The equipment provided for the safe movement of aircraft within the hangar or to and from the flight deck or runway.

nodes.title: Aircraft handling systems servicing and stowage
nodes.definition: Aircraft handling and associated support facilities.

nodes.title: Aircraft recovery support systems
nodes.definition: Aircraft recovery and associated support facilities.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Systems to provide firefighting, machinery cooling, controlled flooding of watertight compartments and some domestic services.

nodes.title: Firemain and flushing systems
nodes.definition: Piping, firemain and flushing pumps, and controls.

nodes.title: Sprinkler systems
nodes.definition: Sea water sprinkler systems.

nodes.title: Pre-wetting systems
nodes.definition: Countermeasure pre-wetting systems.

nodes.title: Auxiliary sea water systems
nodes.definition: Auxiliary machinery sea water system pumps and associated pipes, controls, etc.

nodes.title: Scuppers and deck drains
nodes.definition: Refers to scuppers, deck drains and associated equipment.

nodes.title: Plumbing and drainage
nodes.definition: Refers to drains, plumbing and associated pipes, control valves, etc.

nodes.title: Drainage and ballasting systems
nodes.definition: Refers to piping, drainage and ballasting system, pumps and controllers.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to systems provided for domestic purposes and other services, where the corrosive effect of sea water would be unacceptable.

nodes.title: Distilling plant
nodes.definition: Flash type, vapor compression, heat recovery and submerged tube type.

nodes.title: Auxiliary fresh water cooling
nodes.definition: Cooling water, electronics, DW/CW.

nodes.title: Potable water
nodes.definition: Refers to fresh and distilled water services. It includes, for example, drinking water supplies.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to systems that are designed to move and store propellant and lubricating fluids.

nodes.title: Ship fuel and fuel compensating systems
nodes.definition: Ship fuel filling and transfer system pumps, fuel transfer systems and associated equipment.

nodes.title: Aviation and general purpose fuels
nodes.definition: Piping aviation and general purpose fuel system pumps, aviation and general purpose fuel MOGAS handling and piping.

nodes.title: Aviation and general purpose lubricating oil
nodes.definition: Lubricating oil systems, aviation and general purpose.

nodes.title: Auxiliary lubrication systems
nodes.definition: Lubrication outboard and lubrication inboard.

nodes.title: Special fuel and lubricants handling and storage
nodes.definition: Handling and storage systems for special fuel and lubricants.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Systems that are designed to move and store air and certain gases, under pressure.

nodes.title: Compressed air systems
nodes.definition: This element refers to a system or equipment (hardware/software) for the generation, distribution and/or control of pneumatic power and compressed air.

nodes.title: Compressed gases
nodes.definition: Compressed gas system nitrogen.

nodes.title: Vacuum systems
nodes.definition: This element refers to a system or equipment (hardware/software) for the generation, distribution and/or control of vacuum power.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Cargo handling machinery and systems which are used for replenishment.

nodes.title: RAS systems
nodes.definition: RAS Winches, RAS booms, rigging and hardware, control stations.

nodes.title: Vertical replenishment systems
nodes.definition: VETREP systems.

nodes.title: Ships stores and equipment handling systems
nodes.definition: Refers to ships stores and equipment handling systems.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Any item of machinery other than those directly associated with weapons system not identified elsewhere.

nodes.title: Engineering and functional machinery
nodes.definition: Refers to engineering and functional machinery.

nodes.title: Domestic machinery
nodes.definition: Refers to machinery installed for domestic purposes.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Any item of machinery other than those directly associated with deck machinery.

nodes.title: Cranes
nodes.definition: Refers to cranes used on deck.

nodes.title: Winches
nodes.definition: Refers to winches used on deck.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to provide hazard detection, protection, survivability and escape facilities

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Equipment for the limitation, control and repair (within the platform resources) of material damage however caused in peace and war.

nodes.title: Detection systems
nodes.definition: Refers to equipment for the detection of material damage.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The facilities that are fitted specifically to assist in escaping from danger or to prolong life in times of crisis. It includes, for example, BIBS and HIS

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The equipment that provides the ability to limit the spread of fire, extinguish and prevent re-ignition. It includes, for example, detecting, indicating and extinguishing systems.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: The NBC element refers to those subassemblies or components which provide nuclear, biological and chemical detection, protection and survivability to the platform and crew, either individually or collectively, during an NBC attack. This includes positive pressure and purification systems, ventilated face pieces (masks), NBC detection and warning devices, decontamination equipment and chemical resistant coatings.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to systems for the performance of salvage operations.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Refers to systems for the provision of stability, following damage to or flooding of compartments.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to provide a special mission capability.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to that special equipment (hardware/software) to enable the achievement of a special mission capability.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to that special recovery equipment (hardware/software) to enable the achievement of a recovery capability. It includes cranes, winches and towing equipment.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to that special fit equipment (hardware/software) to enable the achievement of a specialized capability.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: This element refers to that special-to-purpose equipment (hardware/software) for the achievement of a special mission purpose. It covers, for example, equipment for repair workshops, medical and other special purpose platforms.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A function or equipment used to provide habitability, operability or stowage facilities that is not specifically included in other systems.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Coverings made from weatherproof fabrics, plastics and synthetics to protect items of exposed equipment and machinery from the elements (particularly salt water spray)

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Protective paint (usually oil based and anti fouling) applied to surfaces which are exposed to sea water or other corrosive elements.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Spaces that are designed to hold stores of a long term or ready use nature (other than weapons, ammunition and food supplies.

nodes.title: Utility space
nodes.definition: Spaces that are designed and specifically fitted out for the storage or provision of utilities.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Spaces that are designed and specifically fitted out for the provision of bathroom and toilet facilities.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Spaces that are designed and specifically fitted out for the maintenance of machinery and certain specialized equipment.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Rooms that are used for carrying out scientific tests on items of equipment and some substances.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Rooms that are used for carrying out tests on items of equipment.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Rooms that are used for preparation and serving of food and refreshments.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Rooms that are used for storage of food and drink, sometimes with specialized storing requirements such as frozen food.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Spaces that are designed and fitted to provide habitable (living and recreational) accommodation.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Spaces in which work of an administrative nature is carried out.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Rooms that are used for the control of operations and/or processes.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Spaces that contain permanent and fixed items of machinery.

nodes.title: Medical, dental and pharmaceutical spaces, General
General
nodes.definition: Rooms that are used for the provision of medical, dental and pharmaceutical facilities.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: Spaces that are designed and specially fitted for the washing and drying of linen and fabrics.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to provide training capabilities.

nodes.title: Training
nodes.definition: The training element is defined as the deliverable training services, devices, accessories, aids, equipment and facilities used to enable instruction through which personnel will acquire sufficient concepts, skill and aptitudes to operate and maintain the system with maximum efficiency. This element includes all effort associated with the design, development and production of deliverable training equipment as well as the execution of training services.

nodes.title: Non weapon trainers and simulators
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to provide training capabilities for non weapon systems and simulators

nodes.title: Weapon systems trainers and simulators
nodes.definition: A system or equipment used to provide training capabilities for weapon systems and simulators.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system, equipment or facilities used to maintain operational capability.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system, equipment or facilities used to manage the totality of complex integrated management systems.

nodes.title: General
nodes.definition: A system, equipment or facilities used to monitor and manage the totality of Power systems.

nodes.title: Operator facilities
nodes.definition: Refers to the roles and facilities provided to the operator at the Consoles by the MMI

nodes.title: Data processing
nodes.definition: Refers to equipment fitted to a platform, which combines and processes Power systems data

nodes.title: Consoles
nodes.definition: Refers to the consoles fitted to the platform.

nodes.title: Monitor
nodes.definition: Refers to the equipment fitted to the platform which monitors systems.

nodes.title: Cabinets
nodes.definition: Refers to Equipment Cabinets, which can be configured with equipment units from multiple systems.

nodes.title: Maintainer facilities
nodes.definition: Refers to the Maintainers and Diagnostic facilities fitted to the platform

nodes.title: Peripheral equipment
nodes.definition: Refers to any peripheral support equipment fitted to the platform (eg; printers).

nodes.definition: Refers to the roles and facilities provided to the operator at the Consoles by the MMI.
